Hierarchical Control and Operation of Locally Distributed Energy Resources for Enhancing the Bulk Power Grid

Reliability, Resilience, Security, and Economics


Mohammad Shahidehpour, Professor, IEEE Fellow

Robert W. Galvin Center for Electricity Innovation

Illinois Institute of Technology, Chicago, IL 60616

个人简介/ Biography

Dr. Mohammad Shahidehpour is a University Distinguished Professor and Galvin Chair Professor in the Electrical and Computer Engineering Department at Illinois Institute of Technology (IIT). He also serves as the Director of the Robert W. Galvin Center for Electricity Innovation at IIT. He has over 45 years of experience with power system operation, planning, and control and has completed several major projects for the electric energy sector throughout the world. His project on Perfect Power Systems has converted the entire IIT Campus to an islandable microgrid. Dr. Shahidehpour was the recipient of several technical awards including the IEEE Burke Hayes Award for his research on hydrokinetics, IEEE/PES Outstanding Power Engineering Educator Award, IEEE/PES Ramakumar Family Renewable Energy Excellence Award, IEEE/PES Douglas M. Staszesky Distribution Automation Award, and the Edison Electric Institute’s Power Engineering Educator Award. He has co-authored 6 books and over 1000 technical papers on electric power system operation and planning, and served as the founding Editor-in-Chief of the IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid. Dr. Shahidehpour is the recipient of the 2009 honorary doctorate from the Polytechnic University of Bucharest. He is a Fellow of IEEE, Chinese Society of Electric Engineers (CSEE), American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS), and National Academy of Inventors (NAI). He is an academician of the US National Academy of Engineering (NAE). He is also listed as a highly cited researcher on the Web of Science (ranked in the top 1% by citations demonstrating significant influence among his peers).


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Medium Voltage Power Electronics Building Blocksfor Future Electronic Energy Networks


Dushan Borojevich,Professor,IEEE Fellow

Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (Virginia Tech), USA

Member of the U.S. National Academy of Engineering

个人简介/ Biography

Dushan Boroyevich received his Dipl. Ing. degree from the University of Belgrade in 1976 and his M.S. degree from the University of Novi Sad in 1982, in what then used to be Yugoslavia.  He received his Ph.D. degree in 1986 from Virginia Tech, Blacksburg, USA. Between 1986 and 1990, he was an assistant professor and director of the Power and Industrial Electronics Research Program at the University of Novi Sad. He then joined the Bradley Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Virginia Tech as associate professor. He retired from Virginia Tech in 2024 as University Distinguished Professor and as Associate Vice-President for Research and Innovation in Energy Systems. He continues to be active in consulting and promoting new electronic energy networks for energy transition. He was the president of IEEE Power Electronics Society for 2011-12. Dushan was a mentor for 60 Ph.D. dissertations and 50 M.S. theses.

Dushan is a member of the US National Academy of Engineering and is a recipient of 5 honorary professorships in China, as well as numerous other awards, including the IEEE William E. Newell Power Electronics Technical Field Award, the European Power Electronics Association Outstanding Achievement Award, and Ph.D.H.C. from the University of West Bohemia, Czechia. He is IEEE Life Fellow and Fellow of CSEE.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Review of New Development of Functional Induction Thermal Plasmas and its Applications to Materials Processing


Yasunori Tanaka, Professor, Ph.D.

Kanazawa University, Japan

个人简介/ Biography

Yasunori Tanaka received his B.S., M.S., and Ph.D. degrees in electrical engineering from Nagoya University, Japan, in 1993, 1995, and 1998, respectively. In April 1998, he joined Kanazawa University, Japan, as a Research Associate. From August 2002 to March 2010, he served as an Associate Professor at the university. During this period, he was a visiting researcher at the University of California, San Diego (2005, 2006, and 2007), and at the University of Toronto (2007). Since April 2010, he has been a Professor at Kanazawa University, where he currently serves as the Head of the Division of Electronic, Information, and Communication Engineering in the Graduate School of Natural Science and Technology. His research interests encompass the fundamentals and applications of both high-pressure and low-pressure thermal plasmas, employing both numerical and experimental approaches. His work focuses on areas such as nanopowder synthesis, plasma source development, plasma arc cutting, surface modification, diamond growth, and arc interruption phenomena in gas/vacuum circuit breakers.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Smart energy systems


Neven Duić, Professor, Ph.D.

University of Zagreb Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture, Zagreb, Croatia

个人简介/ Biography

Prof. dr. sc. Neven Duić is a full professor at the Department of Energy, Power and Environmental Engineering, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture and Vice-President of Croatian Academy of Engineering. He is president of International Centre for Sustainable Development of Energy, Water and Environment Systems (SDEWES Centre).

Prof. Duić published 200 original scientific papers and 20 review papers in scientific journals referenced in WoS, of which 87 of them are in top 5% of the journal in the category (referring to ISI Web of knowledge data base). His H-index according to Scopus is 67 and according to Web of knowledge data base 60. He is on the Stanford list of 2% most influential scientists.

His main areas of interests are energy policy and planning, smart energy systems, energy economics, sustainable development policy and resource planning, climate change mitigation, energy transition, combustion engineering and modelling, research and innovation policy.

He has worked as consultant on climate change mitigation regulation, emissions trading system, renewable energy, biofuels and buildings for EU and Western Balkans governments.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Investigation of Late Breakdown Phenomena just after a Current Interruption in a Vacuum Circuit Breaker


Eiji Kaneko, Professor

Emeritus Professor of University of the Ryukyus

Adjunct Chief Engineer of TMEIC Corporation

个人简介/ Biography

Eiji Kaneko was born in Aichi prefecture, Japan on September 16th, 1952. He graduated the faculty of engineering, and the graduated school of engineering at Nagoya University, Nagoya, Japan in1975 and 1977, respectively. He got the doctor engineering degree from Nagoya University, Nagoya, Japan in 1986.

He joined High Power Laboratory of Toshiba Corporation in 1977. As a research engineer, he researched vacuum arc phenomena and their application such as vacuum circuit breakers.

In 2002, he joined the faculty of engineering of University of the Ryukyus, Okinawa, Japan. In 2018, he retired from the university and became Professor Emeritus of the University of the Ryukyus.

Since 2018, he has been with TMEIC corporation, Tokyo, Japan, as a part time Chief Engineer of the Substation Systems Engineering Department.

He is a Life Member of IEEE, Fellow and Life Member of IEEJ, and a member of CIGRE.

He is working as a member of the international scientific committee of ISDEIV (International symposium on discharges and electrical insulation in vacuum) and the vice chairman of the international steering committee of ICEPE-ST (International conference on electrical power equipment – switching technology). He joins Mongol University of Science and Technology as a visiting professor, and Tokyo Metropolitan University as a member of an advisory committee.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Development of Optical Methods for Electric Field Sensing


Akiko KUMADA, Professor

The University of Tokyo, Japan

个人简介/ Biography

Akiko Kumada received the B. Eng., M. Eng., and Dr. degrees in Electrical Engineering from the University of Tokyo in 1994, 1996, and 1999, respectively. Since April 2017, she has been in the University of Tokyo as a professor of electrical engineering. She currently serves as vice dean of the graduate school of engineering at the University of Tokyo. Since 2024, she has been serving as a vice president of administration of the IEEE Dielectrics and Electrical Insulation Society.

She directs high voltage laboratory in the University of Tokyo, and is conducting research related to high-voltage insulation and current interruption technology for the development of high-voltage DC transmission networks and the upgrading of existing AC transmission networks.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

TBD


Sergio A. PIGNARI, IEEE Fellow

professor of Politecnico di Milano, Italy

个人简介/ Biography

Sergio A. Pignari is a Full Professor with the Department of Electronics, Information, and Bioengineering at Politecnico di Milano (POLIMI), Italy. From 2015 to 2020, he served as the Chairman of the BSc and MSc study programs in EE at POLIMI. Since 2022, he is serving as the Executive Associate Dean of the XJTU-POLIMI Joint School of Design and Innovation, Xi'an Jiaotong University.

He is the author or co-author of more than 220. His research interests are in the field of EMC.

Dr. Pignari is a Fellow of the IEEE and CSEE. He was co-recipient of the 2005, 2016, and 2021 IEEE EMC Society Transactions Prize Paper Award, and received the IEEE EMC Society Technical Achievement Award in 2011. He is currently serving as an Associate Editor for the IEEE Transactions on Electromagnetic Compatibility. From 2010 to 2015, he served as the IEEE EMC Society Chapter Coordinator. From 2007 to 2009, he was the Chair of the IEEE Italy Section EMC Society Chapter. From 2015-2018, he served as the Italian URSI Officer for Commission E (Electromagnetic Noise and Interference). He has been the Technical Program Chair of the ESA Workshop on Aerospace EMC since 2009, and a Member of the Technical Program Committee of the Asia-Pacific International Symposium on EMC since 2010.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Decarbonization of High-Voltage Switchgear through SF6 Replacement


René Peter Paul SMEETS, PhD, F-IEEE, F-CIGRE

KEMA Labs of CESI Group, Arnhem, the Netherlands

个人简介/ Biography

Rene Peter Paul Smeets received a PhD degree for research work on switchgear in 1987. Until 1995, he was an assistant professor at Eindhoven University. During 1991 he worked with Toshiba Corporation in Japan on vacuum switchgear. In 1995, he joined KEMA, the Netherlands. At present, he is retired from KEMA Laboratories of CESI Group, but still active as an independent advisor. From 2001 - 2013 he was part-time professor at Eindhoven University, the Netherlands. In 2013 he became adjunct professor at Xi’an Jiaotong University, China, after having been connected with this university since 1987.

Dr. Smeets is member of various study/advisory committees of CIGRE after being in the lead of working groups in the field of emerging switching technologies such as HV vacuum switchgear, HVDC switchgear and SF6 alternatives. He was convener of two maintenance teams in IEC on standardization of high-voltage switchgear. In 2008 he was elected Fellow of IEEE and in 2022 he was awarded a Fellowship of CIGRE. He conducted numerous webinars and trainings on ‘switching technology in T&D systems’ for the manufacturing and utilty industry in various parts of the world.

Since 2008 he is chairman of the “Current Zero Club”, a scientific study group on current interruption. Dr. Smeets published and edited three books and authored over 300 international papers on testing and high-voltage switching technology in power systems. He received nine international awards.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Power Electronics — The Key Technology for Grid Integration


Frede Blaabjerg,Professor,IEEE Fellow

Aalborg University, Denmark

个人简介/ Biography

Frede Blaabjerg was with ABB-Scandia, Randers, Denmark, from 1987 to 1988. From 1988 to 1992, he got the PhD degree in Electrical Engineering at Aalborg University in 1995. He became an Assistant Professor in 1992, an Associate Professor in 1996, and a Full Professor of power electronics and drives in 1998 at AAU Energy. From 2017 he became a Villum Investigator. He is honoris causa at University Politehnica Timisoara (UPT), Romania in 2017 and Tallinn Technical University (TTU), Estonia in 2018.

His current research interests include power electronics and its applications such as in wind turbines, PV systems, reliability, Power-2-X, power quality and adjustable speed drives. He has published more than 800 journal papers in the fields of power electronics and its applications. He is the co-author of ten monographs and editor of twenty books in power electronics and its applications eg. the series (4 volumes) Control of Power Electronic Converters and Systems published by Academic Press/Elsevier.He has received 46 IEEE Prize Paper Awards, the IEEE PELS Distinguished Service Award in 2009, the EPE-PEMC Council Award in 2010, the IEEE William E. Newell Power Electronics Award 2014, the Villum Kann Rasmussen Research Award 2014, the Global Energy Prize in 2019 and the 2020 IEEE Edison Medal. He was the Editor-in-Chief of the IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON POWER ELECTRONICS from 2006 to 2012. He has been Distinguished Lecturer for the IEEE Power Electronics Society from 2005 to 2007 and for the IEEE Industry Applications Society from 2010 to 2011 as well as 2017 to 2018. In 2019-2020 he served as a President of IEEE Power Electronics Society. He has been Vice-President of the Danish Academy of Technical Sciences. He is nominated in 2014-2021 by Thomson Reuters to be between the most 250 cited researchers in Engineering in the world.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Assessment on the aging of HVDC Mass Impregnated Cable based on the multi-physical analysis


Bang-Wook Lee, Professor

韩国汉阳大学Hanyang University，South Korea

个人简介/ Biography

Professor Lee was born in 1968 on Jeju Island, South Korea. He received his M.S. and Ph.D. degrees in high voltage engineering from Hanyang University in 1993 and 1998, respectively. Afterward, he worked in research and development at LS Electric as a senior researcher. In 2008, he joined the Department of Electrical Engineering at Hanyang University as a faculty member and has been a full professor ever since. At Hanyang University, he is the Deputy Director of the Industry-Academia Cooperation Center and the Director of the Electric Fusion Research Cente and the DC grid innovation research center, a government-funded project. His research interests include high-voltage power equipment insulation design and analysis, DC grid power system and power equipment R&D. Now he is also a CIGRE SC B1 member in Korea.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Modernization of Electric Power Systems: A Pathway to the Future


CHEN Chen, Professor

Xi’an Jiaotong University, China

个人简介/ Biography

Prof. CHEN Chen is a Professor in the school Electrical Engineering at Xi’an Jiaotong University (XJTU), specializes in power system resilience, active distribution systems, microgrids, demand-side resource management, and smart grid signal processing. He received his Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from Lehigh University (USA) in 2013, after obtaining his M.Eng. (2009) and B.Eng. (2006) degrees from XJTU. Between 2013 and 2019, he conducted postdoctoral research and later served as an Energy Systems Scientist at Argonne National Laboratory (USA), advancing innovations in grid modernization and energy optimization. Since returning to XJTU as a full professor in 2019, his interdisciplinary work integrating power engineering with communications has positioned him as a leading contributor to next-generation smart grid technologies.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Design, actuation, and biomedical applications of magnetic soft robots


ZE Qiji, Professor

Xi’an Jiaotong University, China

个人简介/ Biography

Prof. ZE Qiji is a Professor in the School of Electrical Engineering at Xi’an Jiaotong University (XJTU). He is a pioneering researcher in soft robotics and intelligent soft materials, with a focus on magnetic actuation and electromagnetic control systems. Educated entirely at Xi’an Jiaotong University, he earned his B.Eng. in Electrical Engineering and Automation (2007–2011), followed by a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering (2011–2018). His international research training includes postdoctoral fellowships at The Ohio State University’s Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (2018–2021) and Stanford University’s Department of Mechanical Engineering (2021–2022), where he honed expertise in cross-disciplinary robotics design.


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Hidden Power: The Magic Behind Electromagnetism


DONG Tianyu, Professor

Xi’an Jiaotong University, China

个人简介/ Biography

Prof. DONG Tianyu is a Professor in the School of Electrical Engineering at Xi’an Jiaotong University (XJTU), renowned for pioneering non-Hermitian physics in wireless power transfer and metamaterial-based electromagnetic regulation. Educated entirely at Xi’an Jiaotong University, he earned his B.Eng. (2008) and Ph.D. (2014) under the mentorship of Prof. Ma Xikui, with a pivotal visiting scholarship at Penn State University’s EMC Lab (2011–2013) supervised by electromagnetic luminary Prof. Raj Mittra. Promoted to Associate Professor in 2017 and Full Professor in 2023, he leads the Advanced Electromagnetic Regulation and Energy Conversion Technology Research Center (CAEMEC) and serves as Deputy Director of the Transient Electromagnetic Environment International Joint Research Center (TEA).


邀请报告/ INVITED SPEAKER

Compatibility tests between FRP tube (used to produce composite hollow core insulators for substation apparatus) and insulated oil


Mr.Eric Moal

CTO & Chief External Insulation Technical Expert of SHEMAR Group,France

个人简介/ Biography

Eric Moal was born in 1967. He obtained his Engineering Degree from the ENSEM (Ecole Nationale d’Electricité et de Mécanique) in Nancy (France) in 1990. He works in the field of High Voltage Transmission and Distribution insulation expertise for overhead lines and substations apparatus since more than 30 years. He is currently working as CTO & Chief External Insulation Technical Expert of SHEMAR Group. He is also member of several CIGRE, IEEE, NEMA and IEC standardization working groups, as member, Chair of IEC TC36 (Insulators) and as Convenor for IEC TC36 / MT24 (Substation insulators composite/polymer/hybrid) group.

Open to the program caters to a wide variety of audiences, including undergraduates, graduates, researchers and engineers worldwide with an interest in nuclear engineering, energy systems, or related disciplines.

Akiko Kumada received the B. Eng., M. Eng., and Dr. degrees in Electrical Engineering from the University of Tokyo in 1994, 1996, and 1999, respectively. Since April 2017, she has been in the University of Tokyo as a professor of electrical engineering. She currently serves as vice dean of the graduate school of engineering at the University of Tokyo. Since 2024, she has been serving as a vice president of administration of the IEEE Dielectrics and Electrical Insulation Society.

She directs high voltage laboratory in the University of Tokyo, and is conducting research related to high-voltage insulation and current interruption technology for the development of high-voltage DC transmission networks and the upgrading of existing AC transmission networks.

TBD
Sergio A. PIGNARI, IEEE Fellow
professor of Politecnico di Milano, Italy
个人简介/ Biography

Sergio A. Pignari is a Full Professor with the Department of Electronics, Information, and Bioengineering at Politecnico di Milano (POLIMI), Italy. From 2015 to 2020, he served as the Chairman of the BSc and MSc study programs in EE at POLIMI. Since 2022, he is serving as the Executive Associate Dean of the XJTU-POLIMI Joint School of Design and Innovation, Xi'an Jiaotong University.
He is the author or co-author of more than 220. His research interests are in the field of EMC.

Dr. Pignari is a Fellow of the IEEE and CSEE. He was co-recipient of the 2005, 2016, and 2021 IEEE EMC Society Transactions Prize Paper Award, and received the IEEE EMC Society Technical Achievement Award in 2011. He is currently serving as an Associate Editor for the IEEE Transactions on Electromagnetic Compatibility. From 2010 to 2015, he served as the IEEE EMC Society Chapter Coordinator. From 2007 to 2009, he was the Chair of the IEEE Italy Section EMC Society Chapter. From 2015-2018, he served as the Italian URSI Officer for Commission E (Electromagnetic Noise and Interference). He has been the Technical Program Chair of the ESA Workshop on Aerospace EMC since 2009, and a Member of the Technical Program Committee of the Asia-Pacific International Symposium on EMC since 2010.

Decarbonization of High-Voltage Switchgear through SF6 Replacement
René Peter Paul SMEETS, PhD, F-IEEE, F-CIGRE
KEMA Labs of CESI Group, Arnhem, the Netherlands
个人简介/ Biography

Rene Peter Paul Smeets received a PhD degree for research work on switchgear in 1987. Until 1995, he was an assistant professor at Eindhoven University. During 1991 he worked with Toshiba Corporation in Japan on vacuum switchgear. In 1995, he joined KEMA, the Netherlands. At present, he is retired from KEMA Laboratories of CESI Group, but still active as an independent advisor. From 2001 - 2013 he was part-time professor at Eindhoven University, the Netherlands. In 2013 he became adjunct professor at Xi’an Jiaotong University, China, after having been connected with this university since 1987.

Dr. Smeets is member of various study/advisory committees of CIGRE after being in the lead of working groups in the field of emerging switching technologies such as HV vacuum switchgear, HVDC switchgear and SF6 alternatives. He was convener of two maintenance teams in IEC on standardization of high-voltage switchgear. In 2008 he was elected Fellow of IEEE and in 2022 he was awarded a Fellowship of CIGRE. He conducted numerous webinars and trainings on ‘switching technology in T&D systems’ for the manufacturing and utilty industry in various parts of the world.

Since 2008 he is chairman of the “Current Zero Club”, a scientific study group on current interruption. Dr. Smeets published and edited three books and authored over 300 international papers on testing and high-voltage switching technology in power systems. He received nine international awards.

个人简介/ Biography

Frede Blaabjerg was with ABB-Scandia, Randers, Denmark, from 1987 to 1988. From 1988 to 1992, he got the PhD degree in Electrical Engineering at Aalborg University in 1995. He became an Assistant Professor in 1992, an Associate Professor in 1996, and a Full Professor of power electronics and drives in 1998 at AAU Energy. From 2017 he became a Villum Investigator. He is honoris causa at University Politehnica Timisoara (UPT), Romania in 2017 and Tallinn Technical University (TTU), Estonia in 2018.

His current research interests include power electronics and its applications such as in wind turbines, PV systems, reliability, Power-2-X, power quality and adjustable speed drives. He has published more than 800 journal papers in the fields of power electronics and its applications. He is the co-author of ten monographs and editor of twenty books in power electronics and its applications eg. the series (4 volumes) Control of Power Electronic Converters and Systems published by Academic Press/Elsevier.He has received 46 IEEE Prize Paper Awards, the IEEE PELS Distinguished Service Award in 2009, the EPE-PEMC Council Award in 2010, the IEEE William E. Newell Power Electronics Award 2014, the Villum Kann Rasmussen Research Award 2014, the Global Energy Prize in 2019 and the 2020 IEEE Edison Medal. In 2008, he joined the Department of Electrical Engineering at Hanyang University as a faculty member and has been a full professor ever since. At Hanyang University, he is the Deputy Director of the Industry-Academia Cooperation Center and the Director of the Electric Fusion Research Cente and the DC grid innovation research center, a government-funded project. His research interests include high-voltage power equipment insulation design and analysis, DC grid power system and power equipment R&D. Now he is also a CIGRE SC B1 member in Korea.

CHEN Chen, Professor
Xi’an Jiaotong University, China
个人简介/ Biography

Prof. CHEN Chen is a Professor in the school Electrical Engineering at Xi’an Jiaotong University (XJTU), specializes in power system resilience, active distribution systems, microgrids, demand-side resource management, and smart grid signal processing. He received his Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from Lehigh University (USA) in 2013, after obtaining his M.Eng. (2009) and B.Eng. (2006) degrees from XJTU. Between 2013 and 2019, he conducted postdoctoral research and later served as an Energy Systems Scientist at Argonne National Laboratory (USA), advancing innovations in grid modernization and energy optimization. ZE Qiji, Professor

He is a pioneering researcher in soft robotics and intelligent soft materials, with a focus on magnetic actuation and electromagnetic control systems. Educated entirely at Xi’an Jiaotong University, he earned his B.Eng. in Electrical Engineering and Automation (2007–2011), followed by a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering (2011–2018). His international research training includes postdoctoral fellowships at The Ohio State University’s Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (2018–2021) and Stanford University’s Department of Mechanical Engineering (2021–2022), where he honed expertise in cross-disciplinary robotics design.

DONG Tianyu, Professor

Prof. DONG Tianyu is a Professor in the School of Electrical Engineering at Xi’an Jiaotong University (XJTU), renowned for pioneering non-Hermitian physics in wireless power transfer and metamaterial-based electromagnetic regulation. Vacuum Arc: Theory, Simulation, Experimental Technology and Application
Welcome to the "Vacuum Arc: Theory, Simulation, Experimental Technology and Application" Lecture Series! This event fosters a multidisciplinary exploration of ideas across fundamental science, applied engineering, and industrial practices. Whether you are an electrical engineering or applied physics student, or a professional interested in plasma physics, materials science, and advanced manufacturing technologies, you will gain unique insights and practical knowledge here.
WHY CHOOSE?
✓ Multidisciplinary Integration
Break down disciplinary barriers by merging physics fundamentals, computational modeling, and engineering applications. The course creates a unique "Theory-Simulation-Application" framework, providing a comprehensive understanding of vacuum arc technology.
✓ Progressive Knowledge Structure
Explore the theoretical foundations of vacuum arcs, delve into advanced simulation techniques, and examine cutting-edge experimental methodologies and industrial applications. This structured approach builds a robust knowledge system.
✓ Practice-Oriented Learning
Each theoretical concept is paired with real-world case studies and experimental results, offering practical insights for both research and industrial applications.
CONTENTS:
Module 1: Foundations of Plasma Science
This module provides an in-depth exploration of plasma physics and its properties. Lecture 1 focuses on the fundamentals of plasma, including its production methods and the governing equations that describe plasma behavior. Lecture 2 delves into electron emission mechanisms, discharge classifications, and the critical role of sheaths (plasma boundaries) in understanding how plasma interacts with material surfaces. This module also covers essential techniques in plasma diagnostics.
Module 2: Vacuum Arc Technology and Applications
Building on the foundational knowledge from Module 1, this module explores the specialized domain of vacuum arcs. Lecture 3 examines cathodic (vacuum) arcs in detail, including cathode processes, cathode spots, plasma expansion, and the unique properties of arc plasmas, along with the formation and impact of macroparticles. Lecture 4 then expands the discussion to the diverse applications of plasmas, with a particular emphasis on cathodic (vacuum) arc plasmas. Lecture 5 offers a historical and technical overview of a Hundred Years of Power Switching Technology in Vacuum, providing valuable insights into the evolution and current state of this technology. This includes their use in deposition processes, ion etching, and the role of vacuum arcs in switching technologies.
Module 3: Development of Vacuum Arc Simulation and Experimental Technology
This module explores the evolution and advancements in vacuum arc simulation and experimental techniques. Lecture 6 presents the latest Research Progress on the numerical simulation of multi-component vacuum arcs with different anode modes, highlighting advancements in computational modeling and simulation techniques. Lecture 7 focuses on the behavior and characteristics of Vacuum Arcs in Axial Magnetic Fields, exploring how magnetic fields influence vacuum arc dynamics. Finally, Lecture 8 investigates Vacuum Breakdown at the Nanoscale, covering phenomena such as field emission and electrode deformation, which are crucial for understanding plasma behavior at extremely small scales.
WHO SHOULD ATTEND?
✓ Electrical engineering and Applied Physics Students — Build a strong theoretical foundation and gain practical insights through case studies and experimental methodologies.
✓ Materials Science Researchers — Explore how plasma interactions affect material properties and processing techniques.
✓ Industrial Professionals and Engineers — Discover innovative applications and theoretical knowledge with practical strategies for plasma-based technologies.
Complete eight lectures to receive an International Summer School certificate issued by Xi'an Jiaotong University.
OUR LECTURERS:
1. André ANDERS
Prof. André ANDERS, Leibniz Institute of Surface Engineering (IOM)
Ph.D., Prof. em. Applied Physics, Fellow of APS, AVS, IOP, IEEE, has 40 years of experience using, developing and investigating various plasma and ion beam systems, including, but not limited to, thermionic and cathodic (vacuum) arcs, and magnetron and HiPIMS discharges, with applications from electric propulsion to thin film deposition. Recently, he founded Plasma Engineering LLC, a company located in the San Francico Bay Area focused on consulting and educational services related to plasma and ion beam processing. From 2017 until early 2025, he was the Director and CEO of the Leibniz Institute of Surface Engineering in Leipzig, Germany, a research institute of about 150 people working on surface engineering physical and chemical and physical methods, and in particular plasma and ion beam technologies. He was appointed Professor of Applied Physics (W3) at Leipzig University, Leipzig, Germany, where he taught classes on plasma physics. Before that, from 1992 to 2017, he worked as a Staff Scientist/ Senior Scientist/ Group Leader at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory in Berkeley, CA, and from 1987 to 1991 at the Academy of Science in East Berlin, Germany. He studied physics in Wrocław, Poland, Berlin, (East) Germany, and Moscow (Russia, then Soviet Union), to obtain his PhD degree from Humboldt University in Berlin in 1987. André has authored 3 books and more than 350 peer-reviewed journal papers that are cited over 25,000 times. For ten years (2014-2024) he was the Editor-in-Chief of Journal of Applied Physics, and he currently serves as the Interim Editor-in-Chief of Physics of Fluids, both major journals published by AIP Publishing. His work was recognized by several international awards and the election to Fellow of APS, AVS, IEEE, and the Institute of Physics (UK).
2. Lijun WANG
Prof. Lijun WANG, Xi’an Jiaotong University
Lijun Wang is Professor in Department of Electrical Engineering of Xi’an Jiaotong University, State Key Laboratory of Electrical Insulation and Power Equipment, IEEE Senior Member. From 2009 to 2010, he is a research scholar with Institutes of Research of Electronics and Applied Physics in University of Maryland, College Park. He is engaged in research of modeling and simulation of vacuum arcs and electrode process, numerical design of power equipment, and atmospheric-pressure plasma processing. He has published more than 250 papers, about 140 refereed papers has been published in Applied Physics Letters, IEEE Transactions on Plasma Science, Journal of Applied Physics, Journal of Physics D: Applied Physics and other Journals. He has 7 invited talks in the IEEE International Symposium on Discharges and Electrical Insulation in Vacuum, Asia-Pacific Conference on Plasma and Terahertz Science and International Congress on Energy Fluxes and Radiation Effects and also International Conference on Electric Power Equipment-Switching Technology. Lijun Wang had won Second prize of National Award for Progress in Science and Technology of China in 2012, First prize of The Ministry of Education Natural Science Award of China in 2010, Award for Progress in Science and Technology of Shaanxi Province of China in 2020. Lijun Wang also had won two China Top Cited Paper Awards by IOP Publishing group in 2019 and 2020. The related papers have been selected as the Feature Articles or Cover papers in IEEE Transactions on Plasma Science, Journal of Applied Physics, Plasma Science and Technology.
3. Zhiyuan LIU
Prof. Zhiyuan LIU, Xi’an Jiaotong University
Zhiyuan Liu is Professor of Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi'an, China. He received the Ph.D. degree in electrical engineering from Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, China, in 2001. From 2001 to 2002, he was a senior engineer in the General Electric Company Research and Development Center (Shanghai), Shanghai, China. Since 2003, he has been working in State key laboratory of electrical insulation and power equipment, department of electrical engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, China. Now he is a professor in Xi’an Jiaotong University. He is primarily involved with research and development of high voltage vacuum circuit breakers. He is an IEEE senior member. He is a member of current zero club. He has published 3 books and more than 400 technical papers. He hold more than 100 Chinese patents. He was members of four CIGRE working groups, which were WG A3.27 “The impact of the application of vacuum switchgear at transmission voltages”, JWG A3/B4.34 “Technical requirements and specifications of state-of-the-art DC switching equipment”, WG A3.38 "Shunt Capacitor Switching in Distribution and Transmission Systems: Verification by Tests and Performance in Service", and WG A3.40 “Technical requirements and field experiences with MV DC switching equipment”, respectively.
4. Zongqian SHI
Prof. Zongqian SHI, Xi’an Jiaotong University
Prof. Zongqian Shi was born in 1975. He received the Bachelor’s degree, Master’s degree, and Ph. D. in electrical engineering from Xi’an Jiaotong University, in 1997, 2000, and 2004, respectively. He was a visiting scholar at the University of California, Berkeley in 2009. He has been being a professor with Xi’an Jiaotong University since 2011. He was selected for the Ministry of Education's New Century Talent Support Program in 2011. In 2013, he received the Outstanding Young Scientist Fund of the National Natural Science Foundation of China. He serves as the chief scientist of the project of the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER) program. The fields of interest of Prof. Shi include the theory and application of vacuum discharging plasma, DC interruption, and micro-nano electromagnetic technology. He has published over 130 journal papers and has received the Second Prize of the National Science and Technology Progress Award as well as the First Prize of the Ministry of Education's Natural Science Award.
5. Guodong MENG
Prof. Guodong MENG, Xi’an Jiaotong University
Guodong Meng is Professor with School of Electrical Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University. He received his B.S and Ph. D degrees from Xi’an Jiaotong University in 2007 and 2014, respectively. Then he worked as postdoctoral associate in School of Materials Science and Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University (2014-2015), and Nuclear Science and Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (2015-2016). Since 2016, he joined the faculty of School of Electrical Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University. He has authored over 70 peer-review papers, including Physical Review Letters, Nature Communications, Physics of Plasmas, etc. His research combines electrical engineering, physics and chemistry to thoroughly explore the interaction between electrical field and electrical materials. His work emphasizes developing innovative experimental techniques and simulation methods to investigate the field emission behaviors, materials structure evolution, and electrical breakdown theory in the microscale and nanoscale levels, as well at the plasma-assisted energy conversion for carbon oxidation utilization. Additionally, his work also includes the design and fabrication of two-dimensional materials based advanced sensors, and applying them to the state monitoring for power equipment.

Lecture 2 delves into electron emission mechanisms, discharge classifications, and the critical role of sheaths (plasma boundaries) in understanding how plasma interacts with material surfaces. This module also covers essential techniques in plasma diagnostics.

Module 2: Vacuum Arc Technology and Applications 

Building on the foundational knowledge from Module 1, this module explores the specialized domain of vacuum arcs. Lecture 3 examines cathodic (vacuum) arcs in detail, including cathode processes, cathode spots, plasma expansion, and the unique properties of arc plasmas, along with the formation and impact of macroparticles. Lecture 4 then expands the discussion to the diverse applications of plasmas, with a particular emphasis on cathodic (vacuum) arc plasmas. Lecture 5 offers a historical and technical overview of a Hundred Years of Power Switching Technology in Vacuum, providing valuable insights into the evolution and current state of this technology. This includes their use in deposition processes, ion etching, and the role of vacuum arcs in switching technologies.

Module 3: Development of Vacuum Arc Simulation and Experimental Technology 

This module explores the evolution and advancements in vacuum arc simulation and experimental techniques. Lecture 6 presents the latest Research Progress on the numerical simulation of multi-component vacuum arcs with different anode modes, highlighting advancements in computational modeling and simulation techniques. Lecture 7 focuses on the behavior and characteristics of Vacuum Arcs in Axial Magnetic Fields, exploring how magnetic fields influence vacuum arc dynamics. Finally, Lecture 8 investigates Vacuum Breakdown at the Nanoscale, covering phenomena such as field emission and electrode deformation, which are crucial for understanding plasma behavior at extremely small scales.


WHO SHOULD ATTEND?

✓ Electrical engineering and Applied Physics Students — Build a strong theoretical foundation and gain practical insights through case studies and experimental methodologies.

✓ Materials Science Researchers — Explore how plasma interactions affect material properties and processing techniques.

✓ Industrial Professionals and Engineers — Discover innovative applications and theoretical knowledge with practical strategies for plasma-based technologies.


Complete eight lectures to receive an International Summer School certificate issued by Xi'an Jiaotong University.


OUR LECTURERS:

1. André ANDERS

Prof. André ANDERS, Leibniz Institute of Surface Engineering (IOM)

Ph.D., Prof. em. Applied Physics, Fellow of APS, AVS, IOP, IEEE, has 40 years of experience using, developing and investigating various plasma and ion beam systems, including, but not limited to, thermionic and cathodic (vacuum) arcs, and magnetron and HiPIMS discharges, with applications from electric propulsion to thin film deposition. Recently, he founded Plasma Engineering LLC, a company located in the San Francico Bay Area focused on consulting and educational services related to plasma and ion beam processing. From 2017 until early 2025, he was the Director and CEO of the Leibniz Institute of Surface Engineering in Leipzig, Germany, a research institute of about 150 people working on surface engineering physical and chemical and physical methods, and in particular plasma and ion beam technologies. He was appointed Professor of Applied Physics (W3) at Leipzig University, Leipzig, Germany, where he taught classes on plasma physics. Before that, from 1992 to 2017, he worked as a Staff Scientist/ Senior Scientist/ Group Leader at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory in Berkeley, CA, and from 1987 to 1991 at the Academy of Science in East Berlin, Germany. He studied physics in Wrocław, Poland, Berlin, (East) Germany, and Moscow (Russia, then Soviet Union), to obtain his PhD degree from Humboldt University in Berlin in 1987. André has authored 3 books and more than 350 peer-reviewed journal papers that are cited over 25,000 times. For ten years (2014-2024) he was the Editor-in-Chief of Journal of Applied Physics, and he currently serves as the Interim Editor-in-Chief of Physics of Fluids, both major journals published by AIP Publishing. His work was recognized by several international awards and the election to Fellow of APS, AVS, IEEE, and the Institute of Physics (UK).

2. Lijun WANG

Prof. Lijun WANG, Xi’an Jiaotong University

Lijun Wang is Professor in Department of Electrical Engineering of Xi’an Jiaotong University, State Key Laboratory of Electrical Insulation and Power Equipment, IEEE Senior Member. From 2009 to 2010, he is a research scholar with Institutes of Research of Electronics and Applied Physics in University of Maryland, College Park. He is engaged in research of modeling and simulation of vacuum arcs and electrode process, numerical design of power equipment, and atmospheric-pressure plasma processing. He has published more than 250 papers, about 140 refereed papers has been published in Applied Physics Letters, IEEE Transactions on Plasma Science, Journal of Applied Physics, Journal of Physics D: Applied Physics and other Journals. He has 7 invited talks in the IEEE International Symposium on Discharges and Electrical Insulation in Vacuum, Asia-Pacific Conference on Plasma and Terahertz Science and International Congress on Energy Fluxes and Radiation Effects and also International Conference on Electric Power Equipment-Switching Technology. Lijun Wang had won Second prize of National Award for Progress in Science and Technology of China in 2012, First prize of The Ministry of Education Natural Science Award of China in 2010, Award for Progress in Science and Technology of Shaanxi Province of China in 2020. Lijun Wang also had won two China Top Cited Paper Awards by IOP Publishing group in 2019 and 2020. The related papers have been selected as the Feature Articles or Cover papers in IEEE Transactions on Plasma Science, Journal of Applied Physics, Plasma Science and Technology.

3. Zhiyuan LIU

Prof. Zhiyuan LIU, Xi’an Jiaotong University

Zhiyuan Liu is Professor of Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi'an, China. He received the Ph.D. degree in electrical engineering from Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, China, in 2001. From 2001 to 2002, he was a senior engineer in the General Electric Company Research and Development Center (Shanghai), Shanghai, China. Since 2003, he has been working in State key laboratory of electrical insulation and power equipment, department of electrical engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, China. Now he is a professor in Xi’an Jiaotong University. He is primarily involved with research and development of high voltage vacuum circuit breakers. He is an IEEE senior member. He is a member of current zero club. He has published 3 books and more than 400 technical papers. He hold more than 100 Chinese patents. He was members of four CIGRE working groups, which were WG A3.27 “The impact of the application of vacuum switchgear at transmission voltages”, JWG A3/B4.34 “Technical requirements and specifications of state-of-the-art DC switching equipment”, WG A3.38 "Shunt Capacitor Switching in Distribution and Transmission Systems: Verification by Tests and Performance in Service", and WG A3.40 “Technical requirements and field experiences with MV DC switching equipment”, respectively.

4. Zongqian SHI

Prof. Zongqian SHI, Xi’an Jiaotong University

Prof. Zongqian Shi was born in 1975. He received the Bachelor’s degree, Master’s degree, and Ph. D. in electrical engineering from Xi’an Jiaotong University, in 1997, 2000, and 2004, respectively. He was a visiting scholar at the University of California, Berkeley in 2009. He has been being a professor with Xi’an Jiaotong University since 2011. He was selected for the Ministry of Education's New Century Talent Support Program in 2011. In 2013, he received the Outstanding Young Scientist Fund of the National Natural Science Foundation of China. He serves as the chief scientist of the project of the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER) program. The fields of interest of Prof. Shi include the theory and application of vacuum discharging plasma, DC interruption, and micro-nano electromagnetic technology. He has published over 130 journal papers and has received the Second Prize of the National Science and Technology Progress Award as well as the First Prize of the Ministry of Education's Natural Science Award.

5. Guodong MENG

Prof. Guodong MENG, Xi’an Jiaotong University

Guodong Meng is Professor with School of Electrical Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University. He received his B.S and Ph. D degrees from Xi’an Jiaotong University in 2007 and 2014, respectively. Then he worked as postdoctoral associate in School of Materials Science and Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University (2014-2015), and Nuclear Science and Engineering, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (2015-2016). Since 2016, he joined the faculty of School of Electrical Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University. He has authored over 70 peer-review papers, including Physical Review Letters, Nature Communications, Physics of Plasmas, etc. His research combines electrical engineering, physics and chemistry to thoroughly explore the interaction between electrical field and electrical materials. His work emphasizes developing innovative experimental techniques and simulation methods to investigate the field emission behaviors, materials structure evolution, and electrical breakdown theory in the microscale and nanoscale levels, as well at the plasma-assisted energy conversion for carbon oxidation utilization. Additionally, his work also includes the design and fabrication of two-dimensional materials based advanced sensors, and applying them to the state monitoring for power equipment.

Vacuum Arc: Theory, Simulation, Experimental Technology and Application

Welcome to the "Vacuum Arc: Theory, Simulation, Experimental Technology and Application" Lecture Series! This event fosters a multidisciplinary exploration of ideas across fundamental science, applied engineering, and industrial practices. Whether you are an electrical engineering or applied physics student, or a professional interested in plasma physics, materials science, and advanced manufacturing technologies, you will gain unique insights and practical knowledge here.


WHY CHOOSE?

✓ Multidisciplinary Integration

Break down disciplinary barriers by merging physics fundamentals, computational modeling, and engineering applications. The course creates a unique "Theory-Simulation-Application" framework, providing a comprehensive understanding of vacuum arc technology.

✓ Progressive Knowledge Structure

Explore the theoretical foundations of vacuum arcs, delve into advanced simulation techniques, and examine cutting-edge experimental methodologies and industrial applications. This structured approach builds a robust knowledge system.

✓ Practice-Oriented Learning

Each theoretical concept is paired with real-world case studies and experimental results, offering practical insights for both research and industrial applications.


CONTENTS:

Module 1: Foundations of Plasma Science 

This module provides an in-depth exploration of plasma physics and its properties. Lecture 1 focuses on the fundamentals of plasma, including its production methods and the governing equations that describe plasma behavior. Lecture 2 delves into electron emission mechanisms, discharge classifications, and the critical role of sheaths (plasma boundaries) in understanding how plasma interacts with material surfaces. This module also covers essential techniques in plasma diagnostics.

Module 2: Vacuum Arc Technology and Applications 

Building on the foundational knowledge from Module 1, this module explores the specialized domain of vacuum arcs. Lecture 3 examines cathodic (vacuum) arcs in detail, including cathode processes, cathode spots, plasma expansion, and the unique properties of arc plasmas, along with the formation and impact of macroparticles. Lecture 4 then expands the discussion to the diverse applications of plasmas, with a particular emphasis on cathodic (vacuum) arc plasmas. Lecture 5 offers a historical and technical overview of a Hundred Years of Power Switching Technology in Vacuum, providing valuable insights into the evolution and current state of this technology. This includes their use in deposition processes, ion etching, and the role of vacuum arcs in switching technologies.

Module 3: Development of Vacuum Arc Simulation and Experimental Technology 

This module explores the evolution and advancements in vacuum arc simulation and experimental techniques. Lecture 6 presents the latest Research Progress on the numerical simulation of multi-component vacuum arcs with different anode modes, highlighting advancements in computational modeling and simulation techniques. Lecture 7 focuses on the behavior and characteristics of Vacuum Arcs in Axial Magnetic Fields, exploring how magnetic fields influence vacuum arc dynamics. Finally, Lecture 8 investigates Vacuum Breakdown at the Nanoscale, covering phenomena such as field emission and electrode deformation, which are crucial for understanding plasma behavior at extremely small scales.


WHO SHOULD ATTEND?

✓ Electrical engineering and Applied Physics Students — Build a strong theoretical foundation and gain practical insights through case studies and experimental methodologies.

✓ Materials Science Researchers — Explore how plasma interactions affect material properties and processing techniques.

✓ Industrial Professionals and Engineers — Discover innovative applications and theoretical knowledge with practical strategies for plasma-based technologies.


Complete eight lectures to receive an International Summer School certificate issued by Xi'an Jiaotong University.

Recently, he founded Plasma Engineering LLC, a company located in the San Francico Bay Area focused on consulting and educational services related to plasma and ion beam processing. From 2017 until early 2025, he was the Director and CEO of the Leibniz Institute of Surface Engineering in Leipzig, Germany, a research institute of about 150 people working on surface engineering physical and chemical and physical methods, and in particular plasma and ion beam technologies. He was appointed Professor of Applied Physics (W3) at Leipzig University, Leipzig, Germany, where he taught classes on plasma physics. Before that, from 1992 to 2017, he worked as a Staff Scientist/ Senior Scientist/ Group Leader at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory in Berkeley, CA, and from 1987 to 1991 at the Academy of Science in East Berlin, Germany. He studied physics in Wrocław, Poland, Berlin, (East) Germany, and Moscow (Russia, then Soviet Union), to obtain his PhD degree from Humboldt University in Berlin in 1987. André has authored 3 books and more than 350 peer-reviewed journal papers that are cited over 25,000 times. For ten years (2014-2024) he was the Editor-in-Chief of Journal of Applied Physics, and he currently serves as the Interim Editor-in-Chief of Physics of Fluids, both major journals published by AIP Publishing. His work was recognized by several international awards and the election to Fellow of APS, AVS, IEEE, and the Institute of Physics (UK).

Lijun Wang had won Second prize of National Award for Progress in Science and Technology of China in 2012, First prize of The Ministry of Education Natural Science Award of China in 2010, Award for Progress in Science and Technology of Shaanxi Province of China in 2020. Lijun Wang also had won two China Top Cited Paper Awards by IOP Publishing group in 2019 and 2020. The related papers have been selected as the Feature Articles or Cover papers in IEEE Transactions on Plasma Science, Journal of Applied Physics, Plasma Science and Technology.

3. Zhiyuan LIU

5. Guodong MENG

items.title: [大创项目]关于举办2025年西安交通大学“大学生创新训练项目”成果展暨冠军争夺赛的通知
items.body:
各学院（部）、中心级有关单位：
为贯彻落实《国务院办公厅关于深化高等学校创新创业教育改革的实施意见》（国办发〔2015〕36号）精神，持续激发我校大学生创新创业热情，搭建大学生创新创业实践舞台，加快培养创新创业人才。学校决定举办2025年大学生创新创业成果展。
经专家评审、学院推荐，共选出60项优秀项目拟推荐参加学校大学生创新创业成果展（附件1）。经学校专家组评审遴选，评出18项项目参加本次冠军争夺赛（附件2）。现将有关安排通知如下：
一、 时间
2025年7月11日上午8:30
二、 地点
工程坊A区
三、 活动主题
智创未来·育才报国
四、 答辩安排
冠军争夺赛。由项目负责人答辩，评审专家现场评选（5分钟答辩+2分钟提问），每组决出冠亚季军，其中1名冠军，2名亚军，3名季军。（颁发证书奖金）
请各学院（部）、中心及有关单位积极配合，做好项目的组织、指导和支持工作，确保参展工作的顺利进行。
附件1：2025年西安交通大学大学生创新训练项目成果展入围项目
附件2：2025年西安交通大学大创项目冠军争夺赛参赛项目

items.title: 2024级核工程与核技术（强基计划）补充选拔通知
items.body:
为加快培养国家重大战略领域所需的拔尖创新人才，根据《西安交通大学“强基计划”学生管理办法》（西交本〔2024〕6号），经研究，决定从2024级“强基计划”本科生中选拔部分优秀学生补充进入核工程与核技术（强基计划）专业学习，进入强基专业后按照“强基生”相关要求管理。具体通知如下：
一、申请对象
数学类、物理学、生物技术、工程力学、材料科学与工程专业2024级“强基计划”本科生。
二、申请条件
1.对核工程与核技术有浓厚的专业兴趣、突出的学业专长和发展潜质。
2.“强基计划”正常在读，未被淘汰。
三、录取规则
根据成绩优先的原则，按照考核成绩由高到低的顺序进行录取。
四、考核方式
考核采取面试的方式，面试内容包括学生目前为止所有学业成绩、英语听说能力、对申请专业的了解和认知、未来的学业规划、逻辑思维与创新能力、综合分析能力、交流合作能力、心理素质等。
五、报名及咨询安排
1.报名时间：即日起至2025年7月18日 16:00
2.报名方式：填写以下问卷https://wj.qq.com/s2/23189935/h5d3/
3.报名联系：能动学院教务 闫老师（电话：02982668524，QQ：2136192004）
4.报名材料：（打包上传至问卷）
(1)成绩单（学生事务大厅打印扫描件，或从学校平台申请的电子成绩单）
(2)转专业书面申请书（包括个人转专业的理由，未来规划，对转入专业的理解等等，申请书无固定格式，需要有本人签名）
(3)个人获奖及其他综合能力方面的证明材料。

一、申请对象

数学类、物理学、生物技术、工程力学、材料科学与工程专业2024级“强基计划”本科生。

1.对核工程与核技术有浓厚的专业兴趣、突出的学业专长和发展潜质。

根据成绩优先的原则，按照考核成绩由高到低的顺序进行录取。

(3)个人获奖及其他综合能力方面的证明材料。

items.title: 仪器科学与技术学院2025年转专业笔试及面试安排
items.body:
根据《2025年仪器科学与技术学院本科生转专业工作实施方案》，仪器学院拟对申请转入测控技术与仪器、测控技术与仪器（智能感知工程方向）的学生组织笔试和面试，具体安排如下：
一、 笔试
1. 时间：2025年7月17日（周四）上午8:30-11:00
2. 地点：兴庆校区主楼C-206
3. 科目：高等数学Ⅱ
【注意】 所有申请转专业至仪器学院的学生均需参加笔试考试，请考试当日携带本人学生证或一卡通，提前20分钟到场。
二、 面试
1. 时间：2025年7月18日(周五) 上午8:30-12:00
2. 地点：兴庆校区 中3楼-2331
3. 形式：英文自我介绍（2分钟）+ PPT个人陈述(5分钟，包括个人学习、竞赛经历，对申请专业的认知以及未来的学业规划) + 自由提问（3分钟）
【注意】请同学们携带学生证或一卡通、学生事务大厅出具的成绩单1份，务必提前20分钟到达中3楼-2332教室等候。面试安排不再另行通知学生本人。
请所有报名参加仪器学院2025年转专业的同学务必加入学院转专业咨询QQ群：877109465

items.title: 医学部2025年转专业笔试、综合考查安排的通知
items.body:
根据2025年医学部本科生转专业工作实施方案，现对申请转入医学部学生组织笔试、综合考查，具体安排如下：
一、笔试安排
1.时间：7月18日（星期五）上午9:00-11:00
9:00-10:00 英语
10:00-11:00 高等数学/系统解剖学
11:00-11:30 口腔素描测试（静物写生），考生自备素描用品（铅笔、纸、橡皮、画板），（限申请转入口腔医学专业学生）。
2.地点：解北、解南、病北、病南、微免大教室
具体考场安排请于7月18日上午8点前到解南大教室门口公告栏查看。
3.要求：请同学们务必在7月18日上午8点前持身份证或一卡通到达指定考场按照考场安排表序号列就坐，8:30工作人员将在各考场组织综合考查分组抽签，考试安排不再另行通知本人。
二、综合考查安排
1.时间：7月18日（星期五）下午14:30-18:00
2.地点：财经教学楼四层教室
3.考查方式：
综合考查包括个人情况介绍（10分）、随机抽题做答（20分）/口腔素描（静物写生）（20分）、面试专家提问（10分）等环节。
本次综合考查面试环节实行“双随机”，随机抽签确定综合考查分组和顺序，现场随机抽签确定评委分组名单，面试全程录音录像，不公布学生姓名、学号、专业排名等信息。
4．综合考查分组抽签：7月18日中午8:30工作人员将进入各考场进行综合考查分组抽签，确定综合考查分组和顺序。
请同学们持面试抽签签号前往各面试组参加面试，面试时请向评委展示面试签号。
医学部人才培养处
2025年7月15日

items.title: 2025年基础医学（国家拔尖计划） 补充选拔通知
items.body:
西安交通大学“侯宗濂基础医学拔尖班（国家拔尖计划）”从我校2024级理、工、医类学生中选拔部分优秀学生编入2024级基础医学拔尖班中学习。具体通知如下：
一、申请条件
1. 全校2024级理、工、医类本科生，对基础医学有浓厚的兴趣、学习能力强、具有突出的学业专长和发展潜质的申请者。
2. 成绩要求：一次性通过原专业（类）教学计划规定的全部课程考核，且一学年内所修全部课程不得有三门及以上成绩低于70分。学分成绩须≥80分，或者提供2封我校专家的推荐信（副教授及以上）。
3. 本次选拔不包括2024年西安交通大学《招生章程》中规定的具有转专业限制的学生；钱学森学院各类试验班之间、试验班各模块之间不得相互转专业。
4. 符合学校转专业的其他相关规定。
二、接收计划
1. 接收专业：基础医学（国家拔尖计划）2024级。
2. 接收名额：计划接收不超过6人。
三、审核程序
1. 报名材料提交：符合申请条件的学生请于2025年7月21日8：00之前（以邮箱系统时间为准）将所有报名材料电子版，发送至lhyang@xjtu.edu.cn，邮件主题：姓名+专业班级+2024级基础医学拔尖班报名。报名材料包括：《报名表》、成绩单及其他支撑材料。
未在规定时间内通过邮箱提交报名材料的，视为报名无效。
2. 资格初审：7月21日学院根据“申请条件”对申请者提交的材料进行初审。初审结果将在基础医学院网站公布。同时公布参与综合考核学生名单、考核时间及地点。
3. 考核安排：学院对初审通过的学生进行综合考核。拟定7月22日进行，包括笔试和面试。
（1）笔试：科目为生物学基础，考试时长30分钟；
（2）面试：内容包括学生的思想政治素质、学习潜质、语言表达能力、对专业的了解和未来的学业规划、综合能力等。
4. 公布选拔结果：考核通过的学生名单报教务处、钱学森学院审核，审核通过后，确定最终录取名单并在基础医学院网站公布。
四、录取规则
根据申请者综合考核成绩从高到低排序择优录取，同分者以一年级学分成绩排序。
综合考核成绩=笔试成绩×50%+面试成绩×50%。
五、补修课程
通过选拔的学生将根据培养方案和学生已修读课程确定具体补修、免修方案，解释权归基础医学院。
医学部
基础医学院
2025年7月18日

items.title: [竞赛大创]关于举办2025年大学生新文科实践创新大赛的通知
items.body:
为深入学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，贯彻党的二十大精神和党的二十届三中全会精神，贯彻落实全国教育大会精神和《教育强国建设规划纲要(2024-2035年)》，打造文科实践育人平台，深化文科实践教学改革创新，加强文科实战型人才培养，提高文科教育对经济社会发展的支撑力贡献力，拟举办“2025年大学生新文科实践创新大赛”。
大赛面向全日制在校本科生和研究生，参赛形式为团队赛，鼓励学生跨学科、跨专业、跨学段组队开展实践创新活动，引导学生运用专业知识解决具体实践问题。大赛设置文史哲、经管法、教育、艺术四个组别，学生可根据实践内容从中任选一个组别参赛（具体参赛要求见附件4）。
参赛团队只能选择1个符合要求的组别报名参赛，报名时以参赛团队负责人学籍所在学校作为参赛单位。已获首届大赛决赛金奖、银奖的项目，如内容基本相同并无特别创新进展，不得重复参赛。已获中国国际大学生创新大赛铜奖及以上的项目，不得参赛。
报名截止日期为9月12日，请请各相关学院积极动员、组织学生申报，并对学生提供相应指导、咨询等。
教务处
2025年7月29日

参赛团队只能选择1个符合要求的组别报名参赛，报名时以参赛团队负责人学籍所在学校作为参赛单位。已获首届大赛决赛金奖、银奖的项目，如内容基本相同并无特别创新进展，不得重复参赛。已获中国国际大学生创新大赛铜奖及以上的项目，不得参赛。

报名截止日期为9月12日，请请各相关学院积极动员、组织学生申报，并对学生提供相应指导、咨询等。


 教务处

2025年7月29日

items.title: 关于公示西安交通大学2025年大学生数学建模竞赛校赛结果的通知
items.body:
信息各学院（部、中心）、各参赛队伍：
根据《关于组织开展2025年西安交通大学大学生数学建模竞赛的通知》的安排，本届比赛共有758支本科生团队报名，其中609支队伍参加校赛并成功提交论文。经过交叉阅卷、综合评议，评选出校赛一等奖35队、二等奖69队、三等奖129队、优秀奖134队。其中，获得一、二、三等奖的233支队伍入围推荐国赛的大名单，后续根据参加培训情况、指导教师反馈意见等进行筛选，最终确认代表学校参加国赛的队伍。
现将校赛结果予以公示，公示期自即日起至8月13日。名单中标注黄色有问题的队伍请按要求提供更正信息，过时视为放弃资格。
联系邮箱：shumoa@xjtu.edu.cn，联系人：陈老师、侯老师。
附件： 2025年数模竞赛校赛结果公示V3-1.pdf
实践教学中心
2025年8月10日

items.title: 关于2025-2026学年第一学期本科生报到注册工作的通知
items.body:
各学院（部、中心），全体本科生：
根据学校安排，2025-2026学年第一学期全体本科生（新生除外）开学报到注册时间为2025年9月6日-7日。本次开始，我校本科生可选择线上、线下两种方式进行学籍注册。线上学籍注册为试运行阶段，学生在学校校区范围内可自主登录“移动交通大学”进行线上人脸识别学籍注册，具体操作流程见附件1。线下学籍注册仍在学院本科教务办公室办理。具体工作安排如下：
1.因故未能按时注册者，必须办理请假手续并向所在学院出具有关证明，请假以两周为限。未请假、请假未获批准或逾期未注册者，按退学处理。
2.因休学、保留学籍期满需要复学的学生，请于9月7日前登录教务系统办理复学申请手续。
3.线下学籍注册，本科生需在工作时间携带本人学生证、一卡通前往所在学院本科教务办公室办理注册手续，不得由他人代替注册。
4.请各学院于9月8日上午10:00前，将未按时注册的学生名单报送教务处。
5.9月8日起，学生按照校历和课表安排上课。
注册业务问题咨询：魏老师。
线上注册问题咨询：杜老师，82666769。
教务处
2025年9月3日

items.title: 关于2025年下半年全国大学英语四、六级考试报名的通知
items.body:
根据教育部教育考试院统一安排，2025年下半年全国大学英语四、六级考试笔试（以下简称CET）和口试（以下简称CET-SET）将分别于12月13日、11月22日至23日举行。现将考试报名工作有关事项通知如下：
一、考试科目及时间
1.笔试考试时间
英语四级考试 12月13日 09:00-11:20
英语六级考试 12月13日 15:00-17:25
2.口试考试时间
英语四级口语考试（CET-SET4）考试时间为11月22日（F253次），英语六级口语考试（CET-SET6）考试时间为11月23日（S254次）。具体考试时间见准考证。
二、报名对象
（一）CET报考资格
1.修完大学英语四级课程的普通全日制在校本科生和在籍研究生可报考CET4；
2.修完大学英语六级课程且CET4成绩达到425分及以上的学生可报考CET6；
3.我校不接收外校学生及我校往届已毕(结)业学生的考试报名。
（二）CET-SET报考资格
CET-SET报考资格为完成对应级别笔试科目报考的考生，即完成本次CET4笔试报名后可报考CET-SET4，完成本次CET6笔试报名后可报考CET-SET6。
三、报名时间和方式
（一）报名时间
我省考生网报时间为9月16日11:00至9月26日17:00。
第一阶段时间为9月16日11:00至9月21日17:00，此阶段仅限于我校未参加过CET4(或CET6)考试的学生、及成绩未达到425分的学生报名。
第二阶段时间为9月21日17:00至9月26日17:00，此阶段对我校符合报名要求的考生全部开放，报满为止。
（二）报名方式
笔试、口语考试均采用网上报名方式。考生自行登录http://cet-bm.neea.edu.cn网址，点击相应栏目进行报名，完成用户注册、查证报名资格、个人信息确认、选择报考科目、网上缴费等报名手续。逾期不接受补报名。考生报名前和报名过程中须认真阅读并充分了解网站首页的考生须知、报名流程、常见问题、特别提示等，并同时关注省教育考试院、学校通告等信息。
（三）其他注意事项
1.因考位有限，为保证确有考试需求的学生的报名，凡报名后旷考者，取消下一次考试报名资格。请同学酌情考虑，合理安排考试规划。
2.如我校考位已满，考生可选择“候补”报名，系统将自动排序，填补未按时缴费考生空出的考位。
3.因考场考位数有限，请及时上网报名。报名工作结束后，报名系统关闭，不再接受任何理由的补报名，有考试需求的学生可参加后续考试。
4.如考籍信息有误，请及时与教务处（本科生）、研究生院（研究生）联系。
5.凡上次笔试报名后缺考者，无本次考试报名资格。
（四）收费标准
在校生笔试收费按照《陕价服函〔2018〕164号》规定执行，收费标准为每人每次20元；口试收费标准全国统一为每人每次50元。报名费在网上报名时在线缴付。
（五）准考证打印
成功完成口试报名的考生于11月18日起登录报名系统自行打印准考证；成功完成笔试报名的考生于12月5日起登录报名系统自行打印准考证。参加考试时必须携带纸质准考证。
四、成绩报告单
1.成绩发布10个工作日后，考生可登录中国教育考试网(www.neea.edu.cn)查看并下载电子成绩报告单，电子成绩报告单与纸质成绩报告单同等效力。
2.考生可在报名期间或成绩发布后规定时间内登录 CET 报名网站(cet-bm.neea.edu.cn)自主选择是否需要纸质成绩报告单。
教务处
2025年9月7日

items.title: [大创项目]关于开展2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目”和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目...
items.body:
各学院（部）、中心及有关单位：
根据《西安交通大学本科生科研训练和实践创新基金管理办法》的相关规定，学校决定对2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目”和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”进行中期验收。现将具体事宜通知如下：
一、工作原则
1、以学生为中心，引导学生在实施大创项目过程中契合国家经济社会发展和重大战略需求，解决产业中的实际问题，“真题真做”。鼓励学生将大创项目与高水平竞赛相结合，通过大创项目的实施不断提升各类竞赛水平。
2、鼓励参与过大创项目、特别是通过大创项目有较高水平科研成果的学生持续进行深入的研究。鼓励学生以第一发明人身份申请专利、以第一作者身份发表高水平论文，申请专利、论文版面费用经审核后单列经费支持（论文须标注获得“国家级大学生创新训练计划项目”National Training Program of lnnovation for Undergraduates资助）。
3、2025年西安交通大学大创项目级别评定拟采用“升级、降级、淘汰”的动态管理机制，将结合项目中期的考评结果动态调整项目的评定级别，申请专利及发表论文情况将作为评定大创项目级别依据之一。
4、未参加中期验收的项目视为放弃，不可进行相关费用报销，原则上放弃本年度大创项目的师生不得参加下一年度大创项目申报工作。
二、提交材料内容及要求
1、2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目” （附件1、2）和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”（附件3）立项项目，需在11月15日前完成“大学生创新创业项目智能管理系统”中期检查表以及月进展记录填写工作（3次）。
2、指导老师及学院管理员对2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目”和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”中期检查表以及月进展记录进行查验审核。
3、各学院中期验收预定于11月15日前完成，具体由学院安排，要求各项目负责人参加中期验收答辩（项目负责人陈述限时7分钟，专家提问3分钟），如有实物成果，可在答辩时进行展示。

各学院（部）、中心及有关单位：

根据《西安交通大学本科生科研训练和实践创新基金管理办法》的相关规定，学校决定对2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目”和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”进行中期验收。现将具体事宜通知如下：

一、工作原则

1、以学生为中心，引导学生在实施大创项目过程中契合国家经济社会发展和重大战略需求，解决产业中的实际问题，“真题真做”。鼓励学生将大创项目与高水平竞赛相结合，通过大创项目的实施不断提升各类竞赛水平。

2、鼓励参与过大创项目、特别是通过大创项目有较高水平科研成果的学生持续进行深入的研究。鼓励学生以第一发明人身份申请专利、以第一作者身份发表高水平论文，申请专利、论文版面费用经审核后单列经费支持（论文须标注获得“国家级大学生创新训练计划项目”National Training Program of lnnovation for Undergraduates资助）。

3、2025年西安交通大学大创项目级别评定拟采用“升级、降级、淘汰”的动态管理机制，将结合项目中期的考评结果动态调整项目的评定级别，申请专利及发表论文情况将作为评定大创项目级别依据之一。

4、未参加中期验收的项目视为放弃，不可进行相关费用报销，原则上放弃本年度大创项目的师生不得参加下一年度大创项目申报工作。

二、提交材料内容及要求

1、2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目” （附件1、2）和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”（附件3）立项项目，需在11月15日前完成“大学生创新创业项目智能管理系统”中期检查表以及月进展记录填写工作（3次）。

3、各学院中期验收预定于11月15日前完成，具体由学院安排，要求各项目负责人参加中期验收答辩（项目负责人陈述限时7分钟，专家提问3分钟），如有实物成果，可在答辩时进行展示。

4、若项目发生信息变更，请及时在大创管理系统发起变更申请，附件需上传经指导教师签字、学院同意并盖章的项目信息变更申请表。

三、工作进程

1、中期验收合格的项目可根据预算及报销相关规定进行第一次报销（不超过批准金额50%），11月20日前由各学院管理员统一审核整理报销票据，审核完成后按照附件4顺序排序，以学院为单位交至实践教学中心。

2、各学院需提前一周上报中期验收时间及地点，实践教学中心将安排督导专家进行检查。

3、各学院管理员11月20日前将附件4按答辩成绩从高至低排序，电子版发送至dingxq@xjtu.edu.cn,纸质版答辩成绩单由评审专家及学院负责人签名盖学院章后交至工程坊A区513办公室。

四、其他注意事项及各单位管理员联系方式

1、所有通过大创项目发表的论文，需在文中及致谢处明确标明

获得国家级大学生创新创业训练计划项目（National Training Program of Innovation and Entrepreneurship for Undergraduates ）资助，经费报销时附佐证材料。

2、学院管理员应做好本学院大创项目报销账目记录工作。

3、项目中期验收合格，学生可继续获得实践教学中心大创项目经费支持。

items.title: 关于开展2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目”和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”中期验收的通知
items.body:
各学院（部）、中心及有关单位：
根据《西安交通大学本科生科研训练和实践创新基金管理办法》的相关规定，学校决定对2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目”和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”进行中期验收。现将具体事宜通知如下：
一、工作原则
1、以学生为中心，引导学生在实施大创项目过程中契合国家经济社会发展和重大战略需求，解决产业中的实际问题，“真题真做”。鼓励学生将大创项目与高水平竞赛相结合，通过大创项目的实施不断提升各类竞赛水平。
2、鼓励参与过大创项目、特别是通过大创项目有较高水平科研成果的学生持续进行深入的研究。鼓励学生以第一发明人身份申请专利、以第一作者身份发表高水平论文，申请专利、论文版面费用经审核后单列经费支持（论文须标注获得“国家级大学生创新训练计划项目”National Training Program of lnnovation for Undergraduates资助）。
3、2025年西安交通大学大创项目级别评定拟采用“升级、降级、淘汰”的动态管理机制，将结合项目中期的考评结果动态调整项目的评定级别，申请专利及发表论文情况将作为评定大创项目级别依据之一。
4、未参加中期验收的项目视为放弃，不可进行相关费用报销，原则上放弃本年度大创项目的师生不得参加下一年度大创项目申报工作。
二、提交材料内容及要求
1、2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目” （附件1、2）和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”（附件3）立项项目，需在11月15日前完成“大学生创新创业项目智能管理系统”中期检查表以及月进展记录填写工作（3次）。
2、指导老师及学院管理员对2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目”和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”中期检查表以及月进展记录进行查验审核。
3、各学院中期验收预定于11月15日前完成，具体由学院安排，要求各项目负责人参加中期验收答辩（项目负责人陈述限时7分钟，专家提问3分钟），如有实物成果，可在答辩时进行展示。
4、若项目发生信息变更，请及时在大创管理系统发起变更申请，附件需上传经指导教师签字、学院同意并盖章的项目信息变更申请表。
三、工作进程
1、中期验收合格的项目可根据预算及报销相关规定进行第一次报销（不超过批准金额50%），11月20日前由各学院管理员统一审核整理报销票据，审核完成后按照附件4顺序排序，以学院为单位交至实践教学中心。
2、各学院需提前一周上报中期验收时间及地点，实践教学中心将安排督导专家进行检查。
3、各学院管理员11月20日前将附件4按答辩成绩从高至低排序，电子版发送至dingxq@xjtu.edu.cn,纸质版答辩成绩单由评审专家及学院负责人签名盖学院章后交至工程坊A区513办公室。
四、其他注意事项及各单位管理员联系方式
1、所有通过大创项目发表的论文，需在文中及致谢处明确标明
获得国家级大学生创新创业训练计划项目（National Training Program of Innovation and Entrepreneurship for Undergraduates ）资助，经费报销时附佐证材料。
2、学院管理员应做好本学院大创项目报销账目记录工作。
3、项目中期验收合格，学生可继续获得实践教学中心大创项目经费支持。
4、各单位管理员联系方式
实践教学中心：丁老师 联系电话：82663872

1、2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目” （附件1、2）和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”（附件3）立项项目，需在11月15日前完成“大学生创新创业项目智能管理系统”中期检查表以及月进展记录填写工作（3次）。
2、指导老师及学院管理员对2025年西安交通大学国家级、省级“大学生创新训练项目”和“本科生科研训练和实践创新基金项目”中期检查表以及月进展记录进行查验审核。
3、各学院中期验收预定于11月15日前完成，具体由学院安排，要求各项目负责人参加中期验收答辩（项目负责人陈述限时7分钟，专家提问3分钟），如有实物成果，可在答辩时进行展示。
4、若项目发生信息变更，请及时在大创管理系统发起变更申请，附件需上传经指导教师签字、学院同意并盖章的项目信息变更申请表。
三、工作进程
1、中期验收合格的项目可根据预算及报销相关规定进行第一次报销（不超过批准金额50%），11月20日前由各学院管理员统一审核整理报销票据，审核完成后按照附件4顺序排序，以学院为单位交至实践教学中心。
2、各学院需提前一周上报中期验收时间及地点，实践教学中心将安排督导专家进行检查。
3、各学院管理员11月20日前将附件4按答辩成绩从高至低排序，电子版发送至dingxq@xjtu.edu.cn,纸质版答辩成绩单由评审专家及学院负责人签名盖学院章后交至工程坊A区513办公室。
四、其他注意事项及各单位管理员联系方式
1、所有通过大创项目发表的论文，需在文中及致谢处明确标明
获得国家级大学生创新创业训练计划项目（National Training Program of Innovation and Entrepreneurship for Undergraduates ）资助，经费报销时附佐证材料。
2、学院管理员应做好本学院大创项目报销账目记录工作。
3、项目中期验收合格，学生可继续获得实践教学中心大创项目经费支持。

items.title: 关于开展西安交通大学第十二届大学生物理学术竞赛的通知
items.body:
各学院（部）、中心及有关单位：
为迎接2026年的“第九届西北地区中国大学生物理学术竞赛”和“第十七届中国大学生物理学术竞赛(CUPT)”，提高我校学生的参赛水平，物理学院将联合教务处、钱学森学院和实践教学中心（工程坊）举行“西安交通大学第十二届大学生物理学术竞赛”。少年班、大一、大二和大三的学生都可报名参赛，不缴纳报名费用，报名截止日期为：10月22日。
物理学院将对参赛队伍进行培训并组织校内比赛，在参赛者中选出2-4支优秀队伍代表西安交通大学参加西北地区的比赛并最终选出一支队伍参加全国比赛。09月25日19：30在主楼D104举行大赛赛题发布会和竞赛宣讲会，届时邀请指导教师和往年国赛队员详细分析赛题。
1.报名方法：
（1）线上问卷星：https://www.wjx.cn/vm/evAtnfG.aspx#
（2）线上邮件：请于10月22日晚10点前将电子版报名表发送至邮箱zhailp2018@xjtu.edu.cn。报名表见附件。
【注意】：以上报名方式任选一种，不必重复报名。
2.西安交通大学第九届大学生物理学术竞赛赛程时间节点与安排
（1）2025.9月：赛题分析研讨会；
（2）2025.10月：各位同学自行准备1道选题，撰写理论分析及实验设计方案（题目理解、理论分析、理论结果、数值模拟；设计原理、测量方法、实验仪器、测量数据。赛题的官方发布网站为www.iypt.org，对于题目的理解以官方发布的英文描述为准，注意甄别互联网上的翻译）；
（3）2025.10.22：提交赛题研究PPT到仲英楼B416；
（4）2025.10.25：初赛（第7周周六，准备答辩材料，每人独立的PPT答辩）；
（5）2025.11.22：复赛（第11周周六，指导教师指导以后，在初赛基础上修正改进，加上初步的实验）
（6）2025.12月-2026.03月：复赛结束公布进入决赛名单，进入决赛同学选择第2道选题进行研究，进行决赛准备（预计寒假之前进行一次第2道选题汇报）
（7）2026.3月：集训与校内决赛（校内决赛采用独立答辩和团队答辩相结合的形式进行，具体将在决赛前单独发布决赛组织办法，通过校内决赛选拔参加省赛和西北地区赛的队员）
（8）2026.6月：陕西省省赛、西北地区赛
（9）2026.8月：国赛
联系人：翟立朋

items.title: 关于开展2025年学籍处理与毕业年级确认工作的通知
items.body:
各学院（部、中心）：
根据《西安交通大学本科生学籍管理与学位授予规定》（西交教〔2017〕70号）文件要求，现启动学籍处理与毕业年级确认工作。现将有关情况通知如下：
一、学籍处理
（一）学籍处理范围
在籍在校本科生
（二）处理标准
1.退学警告
学生出现下列情形之一，给予退学警告：
（1）学满一学年，取得所在专业大类(专业)培养方案规定课程的学分累计低于24学分（2021级及以前港澳台生20学分）。
（2）学满二学年，取得所在专业大类(专业)培养方案规定课程的学分累计低于54学分（2021级及以前港澳台生44学分）。
（3）学满三学年，取得所在专业大类(专业)培养方案规定的课程学分累计低于80学分（2021级及以前港澳台生70学分）。
（4）学满四学年，取得所在专业大类(专业)培养方案规定课程的学分累计低于104学分（2021级及以前港澳台生94学分）。
学满学年的计算不包括退学警告的一学年。
2.退学
学生有下列情形之一，给予退学处理：
（1）退学警告期间，修读且取得所在专业大类(专业) 培养方案规定课程的学分低于15学分的；
（2）退学警告期间，修读且取得所在专业大类(专业) 培养方案规定课程的学分达到15学分，但在校期间取得所在专业大类(专业) 培养方案规定课程的学分累计低于第二十六条规定的学年最低学分要求的；
（3）第二次出现退学警告情形的；
（4）在学校规定的最长学习年限内未修完培养方案规定的内容，且未达到结业要求的；
（5）休学、保留学籍期满后两周内未提出复学申请或者复学申请经审查不合格的；
（6）根据学校指定医院诊断，患有疾病或者意外伤残无法继续在校学习的；
（7）未经批准连续两周未参加学校规定的教学活动的；
（8）开学逾期两周未注册而又未履行暂缓注册手续的。
（三）工作要求
1.学生在读期间每学满一学年，均须接受学院组织的学业审查。每个春季、秋季长学期为0.5学年，按此累计计算学满学年数。因休学、保留学籍等原因不能参加审查的学生，待复学后，接受补审查。
2.退学警告期为一学年，原则上退学警告学生降一级。各学院应做好学业指导工作，对退学警告学生以及学业困难学生要精准指导学生制定课程修读计划，避免课业畸轻畸重。各学院协同书院及时告知学生家长，填写“退学警告知情书”，做好退学警告处理工作。
3.学生个人申请退学应提交以下材料：退学审批表、退学申请（本人及家长签名）、书院相关谈话材料、成绩单。
二、毕业年级确认
（一）进入毕业年级条件
学生修读所在专业培养方案规定的课程，四年制学生取得的学分累计达到培养方案总学分的70%，医学五年制学生取得的学分累计达到培养方案总学分（不含集中实习学分）的90%，其他五年制学生取得的学分累计达到培养方案总学分的80%，方可进入毕业年级。
（二）对未进入毕业年级学生的处理
对未进入毕业年级的学生先进行学业审查，完成学籍处理。对达到退学警告条件的学生做退学警告处理，退学警告学生自动降一级。对达到退学条件的学生做退学处理。
无法进入毕业年级且未被学籍处理的学生编入本专业下一年级的相应班级，在编班时请注意保持书院的一致性。
三、工作安排
1.请各学院组织班主任、本科生导师围绕该项工作召开专题会议，认真学习解读学籍管理政策，研判教情学情，稳妥有序安排和推进工作。在此基础上组织各班级召开班会，全面传达解读相关工作要求。
2.请各学院进一步完善工作体系，严格把关，逐一全面组织学业审查，指导相关学生在教务系统完成退学警告、留级申请与审批工作。

各学院（部、中心）：

根据《西安交通大学本科生学籍管理与学位授予规定》（西交教〔2017〕70号）文件要求，现启动学籍处理与毕业年级确认工作。现将有关情况通知如下：

一、学籍处理

（一）学籍处理范围

在籍在校本科生

（二）处理标准

1.退学警告

学生出现下列情形之一，给予退学警告：

（1）学满一学年，取得所在专业大类(专业)培养方案规定课程的学分累计低于24学分（2021级及以前港澳台生20学分）。

（2）学满二学年，取得所在专业大类(专业)培养方案规定课程的学分累计低于54学分（2021级及以前港澳台生44学分）。

（3）学满三学年，取得所在专业大类(专业)培养方案规定的课程学分累计低于80学分（2021级及以前港澳台生70学分）。

（4）学满四学年，取得所在专业大类(专业)培养方案规定课程的学分累计低于104学分（2021级及以前港澳台生94学分）。

学满学年的计算不包括退学警告的一学年。

2.退学

学生有下列情形之一，给予退学处理：

（1）退学警告期间，修读且取得所在专业大类(专业) 培养方案规定课程的学分低于15学分的；

（2）退学警告期间，修读且取得所在专业大类(专业) 培养方案规定课程的学分达到15学分，但在校期间取得所在专业大类(专业) 培养方案规定课程的学分累计低于第二十六条规定的学年最低学分要求的；

（3）第二次出现退学警告情形的；

（4）在学校规定的最长学习年限内未修完培养方案规定的内容，且未达到结业要求的；

（5）休学、保留学籍期满后两周内未提出复学申请或者复学申请经审查不合格的；

（6）根据学校指定医院诊断，患有疾病或者意外伤残无法继续在校学习的；

（7）未经批准连续两周未参加学校规定的教学活动的；

（8）开学逾期两周未注册而又未履行暂缓注册手续的。

（三）工作要求

1.学生在读期间每学满一学年，均须接受学院组织的学业审查。每个春季、秋季长学期为0.5学年，按此累计计算学满学年数。因休学、保留学籍等原因不能参加审查的学生，待复学后，接受补审查。

2.退学警告期为一学年，原则上退学警告学生降一级。各学院应做好学业指导工作，对退学警告学生以及学业困难学生要精准指导学生制定课程修读计划，避免课业畸轻畸重。各学院协同书院及时告知学生家长，填写“退学警告知情书”，做好退学警告处理工作。

3.学生个人申请退学应提交以下材料：退学审批表、退学申请（本人及家长签名）、书院相关谈话材料、成绩单。

二、毕业年级确认

（一）进入毕业年级条件

学生修读所在专业培养方案规定的课程，四年制学生取得的学分累计达到培养方案总学分的70%，医学五年制学生取得的学分累计达到培养方案总学分（不含集中实习学分）的90%，其他五年制学生取得的学分累计达到培养方案总学分的80%，方可进入毕业年级。

（二）对未进入毕业年级学生的处理

对未进入毕业年级的学生先进行学业审查，完成学籍处理。对达到退学警告条件的学生做退学警告处理，退学警告学生自动降一级。对达到退学条件的学生做退学处理。

无法进入毕业年级且未被学籍处理的学生编入本专业下一年级的相应班级，在编班时请注意保持书院的一致性。

三、工作安排

1.请各学院组织班主任、本科生导师围绕该项工作召开专题会议，认真学习解读学籍管理政策，研判教情学情，稳妥有序安排和推进工作。在此基础上组织各班级召开班会，全面传达解读相关工作要求。

2.请各学院进一步完善工作体系，严格把关，逐一全面组织学业审查，指导相关学生在教务系统完成退学警告、留级申请与审批工作。

3.请各学院于9月26日上报相关学生信息（作为学籍处理学生选课名单依据，列表见附件1），于10月17日前完成系统学籍处理流程。

四、学籍异动学生选课

学籍异动学生（以学院提供名单为准）选课时间为：2025年10月9日9：00—10月17日17：00。

1.时间截止后将无法再补退选，请务必在选课期间完成。

3.扩容问题请联系课程开课学院。

4.若选课端无/选不了某门课，请先在选课端全校课表输入课程，点击“检查”查看无法选课原因，对应进行反馈。

items.title: 关于组织开展第十一届国际大学生智能农业装备创新大赛相关工作的通知
items.body:
各学院（部、中心）及有关单位：
创新是引领发展的第一动力，是强农兴农的战略支撑。国际大学生智能农业装备创新大赛（以下简称“大赛”）由国际农业和生物系统工程委员会、中国农业机械学会、中国农业工程学会和农业工程大学国际联盟联合举办。旨在培养学生创新精神、实践能力，激发创新创业灵感，推动高等院校农业装备工程领域创新创业人才培养和农业工程专业学生国际交流。大赛已成为农业装备工程领域颇具影响力、培养学生创新创业能力和综合素质成效显著的大学生竞赛项目，2023年成为中国高等教育学会的“全国普通高校学科竞赛排行榜”正式榜单赛事。
一、大赛介绍
大赛以“智汇农装创未来，科技赋能兴农业”为主题，以培育行业亟需的“专业知识雄厚、动手能力较强、创新创业能力过硬”的现代农业装备创新创业人才为目标，努力创建高校、院所、企业和行业深度参与国内国际双向融合的综合育人平台，助力现代农业装备产业创新发展。
二、参赛对象

items.title: [竞赛大创]关于举办第23届西安交通大学英语辩论赛暨金秋外语节英语辩论赛的通知
items.body:
西安交通大学是最早推行英文辩论的中国高校之一。过去二十余年中，西安交通大学英语辩论系列赛事累计吸引1000余名学生参赛，形成“公正、严谨、卓越”的赛事文化，并持续向“外研社”全国大学生英语辩论赛输送优秀辩手。我校代表队曾多次在“外研社”全国大学生英语辩论赛中荣获全国决赛一等奖。
为进一步深化外语教育改革，培养具有国际视野与批判性思维的高层次人才，现举办第23届西安交通大学英语辩论赛暨金秋外语节英语辩论赛。
一、赛事信息
名称：第23届西安交通大学英语辩论赛暨金秋外语节英语辩论赛
赛制：英国议会制辩论（British Parliamentary Debate, 简称BP Debate）
时间：2025年10月25—26日
地点：兴庆校区外文楼
参赛资格：本、研均可参与（包含国际生），不限专业、年级
二、赛事报名
报名形式：2人组队（可跨院系）
报名群：QQ群：1043666602 。请有报名意向的同学务必加入群聊，单独报名的同学可在群内寻找队友。
报名表获取：请关注PSA pro微信公众号相关推送
报名截止时间：10月12日
三、奖项设置
校赛设一等奖队伍4支、二等奖队伍4支、三等奖队伍4支及“最佳辩手”8名，颁发校级荣誉证书。
获得“最佳辩手”称号的选手可直接进入2026年“外研社”全国大学生英语辩论赛西安交通大学预备队，接受国赛导师组系统训练。
注：“外研社”全国大学生英语辩论赛2020年起连续五年入选中国高等教育学会发布的“全国普通高校学科竞赛排行榜”。
四、培训事宜
赛事主办方提供免费培训活动，具体安排如下：
线上培训：
10月8日 19:00—21:00
平台：腾讯会议（会议号将在报名群内通知）
线下备赛集训：
时间：10月15日15:00—18:00
地点：兴庆校区外文楼，具体教室待定
五、其他事项
为保障赛事有序进行，每支队伍需交50元作为参赛保证金，全程完赛后即全额退还。
本赛事由外国语学院主办，PSA英语公共演说协会协办。赛事详细介绍请关注PSA pro微信公众号。
欢迎有志于提升英语思辨能力、服务国家国际传播战略的同学踊跃报名参与。
外国语学院
2025年9月30日

名称：第23届西安交通大学英语辩论赛暨金秋外语节英语辩论赛
赛制：英国议会制辩论（British Parliamentary Debate, 简称BP Debate）

报名截止时间：10月12日

获得“最佳辩手”称号的选手可直接进入2026年“外研社”全国大学生英语辩论赛西安交通大学预备队，接受国赛导师组系统训练。

为保障赛事有序进行，每支队伍需交50元作为参赛保证金，全程完赛后即全额退还。

items.body:
各学院（部、中心）及参赛学生：
为全面落实立德树人根本任务，深化高校实践创新教育改革，推动新文科建设走深走实，在教育部高等教育司指导下，山东大学发起了“大学生新文科实践创新大赛”。
经专家评审，共有50个参赛团队进入校赛答辩展示环节。本次答辩的特等奖获奖团队将被推荐至国赛，2025年大赛的国赛由我校承办。现将答辩相关事项通知如下：
一、答辩时间及分组
（一）答辩时间
2025年10月9日（周四）14：00-18：35
（二）答辩分组及地点
答辩共分2组进行，分组地点及答辩顺序见附件。请参加答辩的参赛团队按时参加。
二、答辩展示要求
（一）时间安排
每个项目答辩时间为11分钟，其中展示6分钟，专家提问5分钟。请参加答辩展示的团队准备PPT，提前10分钟达到答辩地点，并严格控制展示时间。

第一组：bhzhang19@xjtu.edu.cn

西安交通大学在读本科生，包括国际学生。
往届3MAP比赛二等奖及以上的获奖选手不可再参加此届比赛，其他选手可参加此届比赛，但不得使用之前参赛作品）。

items.title: “百卅恰青春”西安交通大学第47届本科生迎新晚会倾情上演
items.body:
10月18日晚，“百卅恰青春”西安交通大学第47届本科生迎新晚会在兴庆校区思源学生活动中心精彩上演。学校师生代表欢聚一堂，共同见证这场青春盛宴。来自西安交通大学、共青团陕西省委、陕西省教育厅、中国移动陕西公司、VIVO陕西、华商报等有关单位的领导嘉宾出席，还有西北工业大学、西北农林科技大学、西安电子科技大学、长安大学、西北大学及西安外国语大学、西安音乐学院等30余所兄弟高校的学生会代表应邀到场观看。
晚会由“恰逢其时·英才聚交大”“恰合其韵·思源续弦歌”“恰展其华·锦绣汇长卷”“恰乘东风·万里快腾飞”四个篇章组成，通过丰富多彩的文艺节目，展现交大学子的青春活力，新一代交大人满怀希望与憧憬，开启新篇章。
晚会在健身舞蹈协会带来的《舞动青春》中拉开帷幕。舞者们以灵活矫健的身姿、充满节奏感的表演，迅速点燃了现场气氛，为整场晚会注入了蓬勃朝气。
第一篇章：恰逢其时·英才聚交大
第一篇章在《爱的预兆》悠扬深情的交响乐中开启，传递出交大学子对母校的深厚情感。中国舞《一夜鱼龙舞》以灵动舞姿展现学子风采，寓意交大“鱼跃龙门”、蒸蒸日上；歌曲《三国恋》带领观众穿越历史长河，感受激昂情怀；魔术《当下时刻》以精妙手法与现场互动引发阵阵惊叹；歌曲《Sparks Fly》用温暖歌声点亮梦想星火，为第一篇章画上圆满句号。
第二篇章：恰合其韵·思源续弦歌
六名本科新生合唱的《青火》，歌声中满载对未来的执着与憧憬。故事讲述《飞翔》呈现了党国华学长的求学经历与杨铮、强彦龙同学的帮扶故事，温情诠释雷锋精神。《“爱心100”助学行动焕新升级》仪式中，爱心汇聚成海，感动全场。歌曲《向光而行》传递出温暖与力量，激励大家心怀光芒、勇敢追梦。舞蹈《For Girls》则以热烈节奏再次掀起高潮，掌声与欢呼不绝于耳。
第三篇章：恰展其华·锦绣汇长卷
学生艺术团民乐团以恢弘的民乐《象王行》拉开篇章序幕，在丝竹交响间铺展千年文化底蕴。王骏彦等同学的中文串烧将流行与经典巧妙融合，用青春声线点燃全场热情，让潮流活力与校园记忆在音符中交融。学生艺术团舞蹈团（雁塔校区）表演的《醉春风》，舞者们身段灵动如春日飞燕，古典舞姿的雅致与现代编舞的张力相映成趣，在舞台光影里勾勒出东方美学的细腻轮廓。张轲、李泽玺唱响《逆光·闯》，激昂声线穿透会场，将“逆着光也要闯”的奋斗信念注入每一位观众心中。武术协会的《武韵风华》以刀光剑影、刚劲招式，展现中华武术之美，诠释交大人“刚毅坚卓”的精神品格。
第四篇章：恰乘东风·万里快腾飞
学生艺术团合唱团以《想要的一定实现》温暖开篇，和声中寄托对未来的期待。舞蹈团流行舞部带来《Waiting For You》，以极具爆发力的肢体动作展现当代青年的自信果敢。黄慧君、杨君美轻声唱起《是妈妈是女儿》，家常式的歌词如暖心絮语，在浅唱低吟间勾起全场对亲情的眷恋。当旋律转向《交大我爱你》，既是对百廿母校的深情告白，也饱含对未来征程的壮志豪情，让青春理想与家国情怀在此刻同频共振，为晚会画上圆满句号。
现场场务组的工作人员阿孜古丽、杨彤、张培琳说道：“我们的职责是让新生感受到温暖，从路线引导、物资分发到应急处理，都力求细致周到。希望这场晚会成为新生们大学生活的美好起点。”参与合唱节目的吴银同学分享道：“多次排练积累的默契与信心，让我勇敢站上舞台，和团队一起呈现最好的表演。”机械学院的观众于一感慨：“《是妈妈是女儿》让我泪目，歌词道出了我和妈妈之间难以言说的牵挂。”人文2504班的段该留同学觉得：“《逆光·闯》融入了新元素，舞台感染力强，让我全程投入，热血沸腾，每个篇章开始学长学姐的讲述，让我有深深的共鸣，在他们的分享中，我有想去学校里现代与历史碰撞的交汇点看看的冲动，我想进一步去探索这座百年名校，我更加期待我的大学新生活！”

第四篇章：恰乘东风·万里快腾飞

学生艺术团合唱团以《想要的一定实现》温暖开篇，和声中寄托对未来的期待。舞蹈团流行舞部带来《Waiting For You》，以极具爆发力的肢体动作展现当代青年的自信果敢。黄慧君、杨君美轻声唱起《是妈妈是女儿》，家常式的歌词如暖心絮语，在浅唱低吟间勾起全场对亲情的眷恋。当旋律转向《交大我爱你》，既是对百廿母校的深情告白，也饱含对未来征程的壮志豪情，让青春理想与家国情怀在此刻同频共振，为晚会画上圆满句号。

现场场务组的工作人员阿孜古丽、杨彤、张培琳说道：“我们的职责是让新生感受到温暖，从路线引导、物资分发到应急处理，都力求细致周到。希望这场晚会成为新生们大学生活的美好起点。”参与合唱节目的吴银同学分享道：“多次排练积累的默契与信心，让我勇敢站上舞台，和团队一起呈现最好的表演。”机械学院的观众于一感慨：“《是妈妈是女儿》让我泪目，歌词道出了我和妈妈之间难以言说的牵挂。”人文2504班的段该留同学觉得：“《逆光·闯》融入了新元素，舞台感染力强，让我全程投入，热血沸腾，每个篇章开始学长学姐的讲述，让我有深深的共鸣，在他们的分享中，我有想去学校里现代与历史碰撞的交汇点看看的冲动，我想进一步去探索这座百年名校，我更加期待我的大学新生活！”

items.title: 2026电气学院直博生信息确认须知
items.body:
各位2026年9月我院入学的直博生：
网上确认时间：2025年10月24日-10月28日。
具体详见https://yz.xjtu.edu.cn/info/1084/4294.htm
纸质材料提交方式：
1、本校学生请于10月30日前将材料交至兴庆校区东一楼东226或创新港3-2086研究生教务；
2、外校学生请于10月30日（以邮戳时间为准）前将材料邮寄（仅接收EMS或者顺丰）至：
陕西省西安市咸宁西路28号西安交通大学东一楼东226电气学院研究生教务
方老师029-82664000
说明：
1）考生报名纸质材料是重要的档案材料，请认真填写，不得电子签名或者代签。
2）直博生网上信息不需要填写，只需要打印登记卡，连同下载填写的登记表及表格要求的复印件一同交给学院即可。
3）提交材料前注意检查照片是否贴好，签名是否签好、身份证复印件两面复印在一页。
4）材料不要装订，用夹子夹一下就好。
5）本次需要提交纸质材料包括：登记卡、登记表、身份证复印件。
电气学院
2025年10月24日

items.title: 关于2025年秋季《学生体质健康标准》测试的通知
items.body:
根据体育学院教学工作安排，拟对2022级第四学年《国家学生体质健康标准》和2024、2025级身体形态、机能进行测试，现将有关事项通知如下：
一、测试人员
2022、2024、2025级本科生，以及2023级预计下学期需要出国交流的本科生。
二、测试内容
2022级：身高、体重、肺活量、坐位体前屈、50米、立定跳远、引体向上/仰卧起坐、1000米/800米，共8个项目。
2024、2025级：身高、体重、肺活量、坐位体前屈，共4个项目。
三、时间地点
1.兴庆校区：2025年11月1、2日（周六/日），上午8:00-11:00，下午14:00-17:00；测试地点：东南田径场（东北侧羽毛球场检录）。
2.创新港校区：2025年11月8、9日（周六/日），上午8:00-11:00，下午14:00-17:00；测试地点：创新港1号巨构、东小足球场、涵英楼（1号巨构一楼大厅检录）。
3.雁塔校区：2025年11月16日（周日），上午8:00-11:00，下午14:00-17:00；测试地点：财经田径场（田径场西门口检录）。
具体测试时间请以预约的时间为准。
四、测试安排
1.报名：学生扫码自主预约报名，按单元设置数量限制。
2.分组：学生按预约的时间到达指定地点进行检录，现场进行编排分组。
3.实施：测试采用自动化设备，检录后请逐项完成测试。
五、测试要求
1.测试各环节衔接紧密，请严格按照预约的时间到达检录地点，防止影响下一步测试工作。
2.遵守测试纪律及规则，严禁弄虚作假等行为。受试人员必须携带身份证和“校园一卡通”，现场将刷卡进行验证核对，“一卡通”丢失的请于10月30日前完成补办。
3.请严格按照年级要求的测试项目进行测试，2024、2025级不测试素质项目（这4项的测试将在体育课上进行）。
4.因测试人员多、时间紧，测试前不再安排集中活动身体，请参测学生在检录前充分活动身体，穿着适合运动的服装，防止出现运动损伤。
六、注意事项
1.因测试周期历时三个周末，不得以个人事务为由申请缓测。因特殊情况无法在所在校区测试的，可以跨校区预约测试。自愿选择跨校区测试的，请注意来回交通安全。
2.因病因事暂时无法参加测试的，可申请暂缓测试。患有不适合剧烈运动的重大病症或残疾的学生（仅限2022级），可申请免予测试。下载并填写免、缓测《申请表》（见二维码），办理免测的还需携带诊断证明和病历等纸质文件，现场交于体测检录处审核通过后方可缓测或免予测试。（办理免测或缓测的无需再预约体测时间，测试时间内到检录现场办理即可。）
3.每个项目测试结束后即可通过“乐跑”APP按照【校园】-【体质测试】-【一年多测成绩】-【2025-2026学年第一学期】处查询核对体测成绩。如成绩出现缺项、错误等问题，能重测的立即进行重测，不能重测的请在“乐跑”APP-【校园】-【咨询反馈】-“问题分类”选择“体质测试”处进行反馈，反馈时请将测试的时间、组别、错漏情况等描述清楚，体育学院工作人员会对体测成绩进行核查更正。
七、报名方式
本次体测采用扫码预约，选择相应的校区和时间段预约测试，每个时段容量有限，请计划好时间后再进行预约操作，提交后请牢记自己的测试时间，严格按照预约的时间到达检录地点参加测试，检录时需要出示预约界面。
咨询电话：82665953。或加入“2025秋季健康标准”QQ群进行问题反馈，①群：854541306。②群：686436521，群资源有限，请勿重复加群。
体育学院
2025年10月24日

1.兴庆校区：2025年11月1、2日（周六/日），上午8:00-11:00，下午14:00-17:00；测试地点：东南田径场（东北侧羽毛球场检录）。
2.创新港校区：2025年11月8、9日（周六/日），上午8:00-11:00，下午14:00-17:00；测试地点：创新港1号巨构、东小足球场、涵英楼（1号巨构一楼大厅检录）。
3.雁塔校区：2025年11月16日（周日），上午8:00-11:00，下午14:00-17:00；测试地点：财经田径场（田径场西门口检录）。
具体测试时间请以预约的时间为准。
四、测试安排
1.报名：学生扫码自主预约报名，按单元设置数量限制。
2.分组：学生按预约的时间到达指定地点进行检录，现场进行编排分组。
3.实施：测试采用自动化设备，检录后请逐项完成测试。
五、测试要求
1.测试各环节衔接紧密，请严格按照预约的时间到达检录地点，防止影响下一步测试工作。
2.遵守测试纪律及规则，严禁弄虚作假等行为。受试人员必须携带身份证和“校园一卡通”，现场将刷卡进行验证核对，“一卡通”丢失的请于10月30日前完成补办。
3.请严格按照年级要求的测试项目进行测试，2024、2025级不测试素质项目（这4项的测试将在体育课上进行）。
4.因测试人员多、时间紧，测试前不再安排集中活动身体，请参测学生在检录前充分活动身体，穿着适合运动的服装，防止出现运动损伤。
六、注意事项
1.因测试周期历时三个周末，不得以个人事务为由申请缓测。因特殊情况无法在所在校区测试的，可以跨校区预约测试。自愿选择跨校区测试的，请注意来回交通安全。
2.因病因事暂时无法参加测试的，可申请暂缓测试。患有不适合剧烈运动的重大病症或残疾的学生（仅限2022级），可申请免予测试。下载并填写免、缓测《申请表》（见二维码），办理免测的还需携带诊断证明和病历等纸质文件，现场交于体测检录处审核通过后方可缓测或免予测试。（办理免测或缓测的无需再预约体测时间，测试时间内到检录现场办理即可。）
3.每个项目测试结束后即可通过“乐跑”APP按照【校园】-【体质测试】-【一年多测成绩】-【2025-2026学年第一学期】处查询核对体测成绩。如成绩出现缺项、错误等问题，能重测的立即进行重测，不能重测的请在“乐跑”APP-【校园】-【咨询反馈】-“问题分类”选择“体质测试”处进行反馈，反馈时请将测试的时间、组别、错漏情况等描述清楚，体育学院工作人员会对体测成绩进行核查更正。
七、报名方式
本次体测采用扫码预约，选择相应的校区和时间段预约测试，每个时段容量有限，请计划好时间后再进行预约操作，提交后请牢记自己的测试时间，严格按照预约的时间到达检录地点参加测试，检录时需要出示预约界面。

items.title: 西安交通大学电气工程学院2026年普通招考博士研究生“申请-考核”制实施细则
items.body:
为了选拔和培养适应现代科学技术发展需要的创新型人才，根据学院根据《西安交通大学博士研究生招生工作管理规定》和《西安交通大学2026年博士研究生招生章程》，特制订电气工程学院2026年普通招考博士研究生“申请-考核”制实施细则。
一、招生规模
2026年电气工程学院拟招收攻读博士学位研究生220名（含普通招考、硕博连读、直博生及各类专项计划），实际录取人数以最终录取结果为准。
二、申请程序
（一）申请条件
中华人民共和国公民；拥护中国共产党的领导，品德良好，遵纪守法；身体健康符合国家和学校规定的体检要求。
（二）具体要求
1. 已获硕士学位；应届硕士毕业生（最迟须在博士录取当年入学前取得硕士学位）。
2. 具有较好的英语听、说、读、写能力，水平达到以下要求之一：
（1）全国大学英语四级考试成绩达到 425 分及以上；
（2）TOEFL 成绩达到 80 分及以上（IBT）；
（3）IELTS 成绩达到 6.0 分及以上；
（4）GRE 成绩达到 300 分及以上（新）；
（5）GMAT 成绩达到 650 分及以上；
（6）WSK（PETS-5）考试合格；
（7）全国高校外语专业八级考试 TEM-8 合格；
（8）曾在英语语言国家留学/工作 2 年以上或取得境外学位。
3.符合以下条件的人员，向学院提出申请，经同意后可按硕士毕业生同等学力报考：
（1）获得学士学位后在所要申请专业、学科或相近的领域工作六年及以上（从获得学士学位到博士生入学之日）；
（2）已修完硕士研究生课程，由研究生管理部门出具成绩证明；
（3）具有较强的科研能力，已在报考学科、专业或相近研究领域获得省部级科技成果二等奖及以上（本人排名前三）；
三、报名
（一）网上报名
时间：2025年11月4日-2025年11月18日(普通招考)。
网址：西安交通大学研究生招生信息网(http://yz.xjtu.edu.cn)。
登录网上报名系统，按《网报须知》要求填报本人信息及上传本人电子照片等相关资料，并缴纳报名费，下载确认报名情况登记卡及报名相关表格。报名期间未缴纳报名费者报名无效，报名费不予退还。
凡不按要求或不符合条件及相关政策报名、网报信息误填、错填或填报虚假信息、未及时准确提供有关材料而造成不能考核或录取的，后果由考生本人承担。
本校硕士研究生硕转博资格考核网上报名时间、专项报名、直博生信息确认时间另见相关通知。
（二）申请材料清单
考生须向学院提交以下基本材料,逾期或所交材料不全者，按放弃处理：
1．博士生考生报名情况登记卡(报名完成后系统生成，双面打印，须经本人签字)；
2．报考攻读博士学位研究生登记表（在报名网页下载空白表手工填写）；
3．两份推荐书。一份由报考博士导师填写，另一份由所报考学科专业领域内的教授（或相当专业技术职称的专家）填写（报名网页下载）；
4．硕士课程学习成绩单（加盖公章或成绩专用章有效）；
5．外语水平证明材料（含全国大学英语四六级证书、TOEFL成绩单、IELTS成绩单、GRE成绩单等复印件）；
6．公开发表的学术论文、所获专利及其它研究成果证明，承担科研情况简表（公开发表的学术论文、所获专利、获奖证书等复印件）；
7．学士、硕士学位证书原件及复印件，本科、研究生毕业证书原件及复印件或证明书，须提供有效期内的学历及学位认证报告。持国（境）外学位证书申请者须提供（中国）教育部留学服务中心出具的《国（境）外学历学位认证书》（查验原件，收取复印件）；
8．应届生须提供研究生部门开具的应届生证明或教育部学籍在线验证报告（验证报告的预计毕业日期为2026年8月前），在入学前补交学位证书及毕业证书复印件。持国（境）外学位证书申请者报名时未取得《国（境）外学历学位认证书》须提交相关证明及个人承诺书；
9．本人身份证复印件；
10．报考博士研究生个人简况表（请从本文件的附件下载）；
11．科研计划书。要求考生结合拟报考导师的研究方向，撰写一份科研计划书，计划书内容包括研究目的、研究背景、研究内容、研究方案、创新点等，要求字数不少于5000字，列出必要的参考文献。（请从本文件的附件下载）。
注意：材料可分类装订（禁止装订到一起），可用长尾夹按照以上顺序整理。
（三）材料提交
考生网上报名和缴费后，于11月19日（含）前可通过两种方式之一前提交材料，其中材料第5、6、7、9项仅需提交复印件：
1.直接将申请材料提交到电气工程学院研究生教学办（兴庆校区东一楼二层东226房间）。
2.邮寄至电气学院研究生教学办（请使用EMS或者顺丰邮寄，其他快递不受理，截止时间以邮件寄出时间为准）
通信地址如下：
地 址：陕西省西安市咸宁西路28号
收件人：西安交通大学电气工程学院研究生教学办公室方老师
邮 编：710049
电 话：(029)82664000
备注：①若递交的申请材料不全或无缴费，将不予受理。
②一旦发现弄虚作假行为，将取消资格考核和录取资格。
③ 材料一经提交，均不退还。
（四）现场确认
现场确认时携带第5、6、7、9项材料原件到电气工程学院研究生教学办进行，现场确认时间另行通知。
四、申请-考核制办法
1.资格审查（初审）
学院成立的博士生招生选拔工作组根据考生在报名系统中提交的基本资料，对考生首先进行资格审查，以形式审查为主，主要审查考生的报考资格。资格审查通过的考生，进入下一个环节。
2.材料评议（占总成绩的30％）
材料评议采用电子材料评议，考核小组专家对考生提交的电子材料从学习经历、工作经历、科研情况、学术水平、攻读博士的研究计划书、推荐书等方面进行评议，对申请者的材料进行全面的、独立的评估、打分。由学院制定材料评议通过标准，不合格者不能进入下一环节。材料评议结果将于12月下旬在电气学院主页通知公告栏公布。
3.综合面试（占总成绩的70％）
综合面试时间:2026年4月底，具体安排见电气学院主页通知。
学院成立由博士生导师组成的考核专家组，主要考核申请者的科研志趣、逻辑思维与语言表达能力、创新意识与分析解决问题的能力。PPT内容包括：
l 用英文进行个人基本情况和前期成果介绍；
l 学术报告（可结合硕士期间的研究内容或自选以前从事过的研究项目）；
l 科研计划报告，即对考生撰写的科研计划书进行报告。
专家根据考生的报告情况，对考生的科研志趣、逻辑思维与语言表达能力、创新意识与分析解决问题等进行综合能力评价，按百分制给出分数。综合面试成绩不及格者不能录取。
5. 其他
同等学力考生须参加由学校组织的自然辩证法和两门硕士阶段专业基础课考核。持境外学位考生须参加政治理论考核。不合格者不予录取。
五、录取
根据考生考核综合成绩、思想品德表现、身体健康状况、学院的招生名额、指导教师招生情况、导师考生双向选择，择优录取。重复录取的考生，学校有权取消其录取资格，一切后果考生自行承担。
六、入学时间
2026年9月。
七、其他说明
1．报考我院博士的考生，报名前必须和报考导师沟通，报考导师同意后方可报考。
2．学院依据年度招生总计划，根据接收直接攻博和硕博连读（资格考核）人数调整普通招考的招生计划。
3．直接攻读博士学位研究生的本校及外校应届本科毕业生，依据《2026年 推免生接收章程》执行，入学前按照学院通知做好博士生网上信息确认、博士报名登记表填写等相关信息填报及确认工作，信息确认时间另行通知。
4．本校在读硕士研究生通过资格考核方式申请攻读博士学位研究生,按照《西安交通大学博士生资格考核实施办法》文件执行，报名和考核要求详见学院通知。
5．考生如存在报考信息弄虚作假、违反招生规定、存在品德失范、学术不端或违法违纪违规等情况的，经相关部门查证属实，学校将按照相关规定取消其报考资格、录取资格或入学资格等，产生的一切后果由本人负责。
6．其它未尽事宜按照《西安交通大学2026年博士研究生招生章程》执行，本方案的最终解释权归西安交通大学电气工程学院。
八、咨询方式
咨询电话：(029)82664000，88964000 方老师
咨询邮箱: fangli2004@xjtu.edu.cn
投诉监督邮箱：eeyjs@xjtu.edu.cn
电气学院网址：http://ee.xjtu.edu.cn
西安交通大学电气工程学院
2025年10月27日
